title.zh: 卷2 帝紀第2 高祖下
title.raw: 卷2 帝紀第2 高祖下 Volume 2 Annals 2: Gaozu 2

sentences.zh: 八年春正月乙亥，陳遣散騎常侍袁雅、兼通直散騎常侍周止水來聘。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the eighth year, on the day yihai, Chen sent Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Yuan Ya and Acting Direct Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Zhou Zhishui on a goodwill mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the eighth year, on the day yihai, Chen sent Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Yuan Ya and Acting Direct Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Zhou Zhishui on a goodwill mission.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，鎮星入東井。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengzi, Saturn entered the Eastern Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day gengzi, Saturn entered the Eastern Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，陳人寇硤州。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Chen raided Xia Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, Chen raided Xia Province.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，上柱國、隴西郡公李詢卒。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinwei, Senior General of the First Rank and Duke of Longxi County Li Xun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day xinwei, Senior General of the First Rank and Duke of Longxi County Li Xun died.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以成州刺史姜須達為會州總管。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Jiang Xuda, Prefect of Cheng Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Hui Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, Jiang Xuda, Prefect of Cheng Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Hui Province.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣兼散騎常侍程尚賢、兼通直散騎常侍韋惲使于陳。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Acting Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Cheng Shangxian and Acting Direct Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Wei Yun were dispatched as envoys to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu, Acting Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Cheng Shangxian and Acting Direct Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Wei Yun were dispatched as envoys to Chen.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔曰：

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, an edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, an edict stated:

sentences.zh: 昔有苗不賓，唐堯薄伐，孫皓僭虐，晉武行誅。

translations.literal: In ancient times the Miao did not submit; Tang Yao carried out a limited punitive campaign; Sun Hao was tyrannical and cruel, and Jin Wu executed him.
translations.idiomatic: In ancient times the Miao would not submit, so Tang Yao launched a restrained punitive campaign; Sun Hao ruled with usurped cruelty, and Jin Wu put him to death.

sentences.zh: 有陳竊據江表，逆天暴物。

translations.literal: Chen has seized and held the lands south of the Yangzi, defying Heaven and ravaging creatures.
translations.idiomatic: Chen has seized the lands south of the Yangzi, defying Heaven and ravaging the people.

sentences.zh: 朕初受命，陳頊尚存，思欲教之以道，不以龔行為令，往來修睦，望其遷善。

translations.literal: When I first received the Mandate, Chen Xu was still alive; I wished to instruct him in the Way, and did not issue an order for a punitive expedition; we exchanged envoys to cultivate harmony, hoping he would turn toward goodness.
translations.idiomatic: When I first received the Mandate, Chen Xu was still alive. I wished to guide him by the Way and did not issue an order for a punitive expedition. We exchanged envoys to cultivate harmony, hoping he would turn toward goodness.

sentences.zh: 時日無幾，釁惡已聞。

translations.literal: Before long, reports of provocation and wickedness were already heard.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, reports of provocation and wickedness were already reaching us.

sentences.zh: 厚納叛亡，侵犯城戍，勾吳、閩越，肆厥殘忍。

translations.literal: They generously welcomed defectors and fugitives, violated frontier garrisons, and together with Wu and Minyue they indulged their cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: They lavishly welcomed defectors and fugitives, violated frontier garrisons, and together with Wu and Minyue indulged their cruelty.

sentences.zh: 于時王師大舉，將一車書，陳頊反地收兵，深懷震懼，責躬請約，俄而致殞。

translations.literal: At that time the imperial army launched a major campaign, intending to unify the realm under one law and script; Chen Xu returned territory and recalled troops, deeply shaken and terrified; he blamed himself and requested a pact, and soon afterward died.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the imperial army launched a major campaign, intending to unify the realm under one law and one script. Chen Xu returned territory and recalled his troops, deeply shaken and terrified. He blamed himself and requested a pact, and soon afterward died.

sentences.zh: 矜其喪禍，仍詔班師。

translations.literal: Out of pity for his calamity and death, I still ordered the army to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Out of pity for his calamity and death, I still ordered the army to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 叔寶承風，因求繼好，載佇克念，共敦行李。

translations.literal: Chen Shubao, riding that momentum, then sought to continue friendly relations; both sides waited in hopes of renewed harmony and together cultivated diplomatic exchange.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shubao, riding that momentum, then sought to continue friendly relations. Both sides waited in hopes of renewed harmony and together cultivated diplomatic exchange.

sentences.zh: 每見珪璪入朝，輶軒出使，何嘗不殷勤曉喻，戒以惟新。

translations.literal: Whenever I saw jade tokens and seals arrive for audience, or chariots depart on missions, how could I not earnestly instruct and admonish, warning them to make a fresh start?
translations.idiomatic: Whenever I saw jade tokens and seals arrive for audience, or envoys' chariots depart on missions, how could I not earnestly instruct and admonish them, urging them to make a fresh start?

sentences.zh: 而狼子之心，出而彌野，威侮五行，怠棄三正，誅翦骨肉，夷滅才良。

translations.literal: Yet the heart of a wolf cub, once unleashed, grows only wilder; he has insulted the five phases, abandoned the three correct beginnings, executed kinsmen, and wiped out men of talent and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the heart of a wolf cub, once unleashed, grows only wilder. He has insulted the five phases, abandoned the three correct beginnings, executed his kinsmen, and wiped out men of talent and virtue.

sentences.zh: 據手掌之地，恣溪壑之險，劫奪閭閻，資產俱竭，驅蹙內外，勞役弗已。

translations.literal: On land no larger than a palm he indulges gorge and ravine rapacity; he plunders within the wards, exhausting every household's wealth; he drives and harasses inside and out, forcing corvée labor without cease.
translations.idiomatic: On land no larger than a palm he indulges gorge-deep greed; he plunders within the wards until every household's wealth is exhausted; he drives and harasses inside and out, forcing corvée labor without cease.

sentences.zh: 徵責女子，擅造宮室，日增月益，止足無期，帷薄嬪嬙，有踰萬數。

translations.literal: He levied women as tribute, built palaces on his own authority, adding to them month after month with no end in sight; behind curtains his consorts and concubines number more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He levied women as tribute and built palaces on his own authority, adding to them month after month with no end in sight. Behind the curtains his consorts and concubines number more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 寶衣玉食，窮奢極侈，淫聲樂飲，俾晝作夜。

translations.literal: Precious robes and jade fare, the utmost extravagance and excess; licentious music and drunken revelry, turning day into night.
translations.idiomatic: Precious robes and jade fare, the utmost extravagance and excess; licentious music and drunken revelry, turning day into night.

sentences.zh: 斬直言之客，滅無罪之家，剖人之肝，分人之血。

translations.literal: He cut down guests who spoke blunt truth, destroyed families guilty of no crime, cut open men's livers, and divided men's blood.
translations.idiomatic: He cut down guests who spoke blunt truth, destroyed families guilty of no crime, cut open men's livers, and divided men's blood.

sentences.zh: 欺天造惡，祭鬼求恩，歌儛衢路，酣醉宮閫。

translations.literal: He deceived Heaven and created wickedness, sacrificed to ghosts to beg for favor, sang and danced in the streets, and drank himself senseless within the palace gates.
translations.idiomatic: He deceived Heaven and created wickedness, sacrificed to ghosts to beg for favor, sang and danced in the streets, and drank himself senseless within the palace gates.

sentences.zh: 盛粉黛而執干戈，曳羅綺而呼警蹕，躍馬振策，從旦至昏，無所經營，馳走不息。

translations.literal: Beddecked in powder and rouge he bore weapons; trailing silks and brocades he shouted for the imperial guard to clear the way; he spurred his horse and whipped it from dawn to dusk, attending to nothing but relentless riding without rest.
translations.idiomatic: Beddecked in powder and rouge he bore weapons; trailing silks and brocades he shouted for the imperial guard to clear the way; he spurred his horse and whipped it from dawn to dusk, attending to nothing but relentless riding without rest.

sentences.zh: 負甲持仗，隨逐徒行，追而不及，即加罪譴。

translations.literal: Soldiers bearing armor and weapons had to follow on foot in his train; if they could not keep up they were immediately punished.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers bearing armor and weapons had to follow on foot in his train; if they could not keep up they were immediately punished.

sentences.zh: 自古昏亂，罕或能比。

translations.literal: Since antiquity, among the deluded and chaotic, few can compare.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity, among the deluded and chaotic, few can compare with him.

sentences.zh: 介士武夫，飢寒力役，筋髓罄於土木，性命俟於溝渠。

translations.literal: Common warriors, hungry, cold, and forced into labor — their sinews and marrow are exhausted in earth and timber, their lives await the ditch and culvert.
translations.idiomatic: Common warriors, hungry, cold, and forced into labor — their sinews and marrow are exhausted in earthworks and timber, their lives await the ditch and culvert.

sentences.zh: 君子潛逃，小人得志，家家隱殺戮，各各任聚歛。

translations.literal: Gentlefolk flee in hiding; petty men get their way; in every household slaughter is concealed, and each one abuses his power to levy exactions.
translations.idiomatic: Gentlefolk flee in hiding while petty men get their way; in every household slaughter is concealed, and each man abuses his power to levy exactions.

sentences.zh: 天災地孽，物怪人妖，衣冠鉗口，道路以目。

translations.literal: Heaven-sent disasters and earth-born portents, strange things and human omens — men of rank clench their mouths shut, and on the road people dare only look with their eyes.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven-sent disasters and earth-born portents, strange things and human omens — men of rank clench their mouths shut, and on the road people dare only look with their eyes.

sentences.zh: 傾心翹足，誓告於我，日月以冀，文奏相尋。

translations.literal: With all their heart they stretch their necks and stand on tiptoe, swearing appeals to me; day after day they hope; written petitions follow one after another.
translations.idiomatic: With all their heart they stretch their necks and stand on tiptoe, swearing appeals to me; day after day they hope, and written petitions follow one after another.

sentences.zh: 重以背德違言，搖蕩疆埸，巴峽之下，海澨已西，江北、江南，為鬼為蜮。

translations.literal: Add to this betrayal of virtue and violation of promises, shaking the borders — below the Ba gorges and west of the sea shore, north and south of the Yangzi, people have become ghosts and goblins.
translations.idiomatic: Add to this betrayal of virtue and violation of promises, shaking the borders — below the Ba gorges and west of the sea shore, north and south of the Yangzi, people have become ghosts and goblins.

sentences.zh: 死隴窮發掘之酷，生居極攘奪之苦，抄掠人畜，斷截樵蘇，市井不立，農事廢寢。

translations.literal: After death they suffer the cruelty of looted tombs; while alive they endure the utmost pain of plunder and seizure; livestock are seized, firewood cut off, markets no longer stand, and farming is abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: After death they suffer the cruelty of looted tombs; while alive they endure the utmost pain of plunder and seizure. Livestock are seized, firewood cut off, markets no longer stand, and farming is abandoned.

sentences.zh: 歷陽、廣陵，窺覦相繼，或謀圖城邑，或劫剝吏人，晝伏夜遊，鼠竄狗盜。

translations.literal: At Liyang and Guangling they cast greedy eyes one after another; some plot to seize cities, others rob officials and people; by day they hide, by night they roam, like rats scurrying and dogs stealing.
translations.idiomatic: At Liyang and Guangling they cast greedy eyes one after another; some plot to seize cities, others rob officials and people. By day they hide, by night they roam, like rats scurrying and dogs stealing.

sentences.zh: 彼則羸兵敝卒，來必就擒，此則重門設險，有勞藩捍。

translations.literal: When their weakened troops and worn-out soldiers come, they are always captured; yet here our heavily guarded passes and defenses require constant labor from frontier defenders.
translations.idiomatic: When their weakened troops and worn-out soldiers come, they are always captured; yet here our heavily guarded passes and defenses require constant labor from frontier defenders.

sentences.zh: 天之所覆，無非朕臣，每關聽覽，有懷傷惻。

translations.literal: All that Heaven covers, none are not my subjects; whenever these matters reach my ears, my heart is full of anguish.
translations.idiomatic: All that Heaven covers, none are not my subjects; whenever these matters reach my ears, my heart is full of anguish.

sentences.zh: 有梁之國，我南藩也，其君入朝，潛相招誘，不顧朕恩。

translations.literal: The State of Liang is my southern frontier dependency; when its ruler came to court, Chen secretly tried to entice him and showed no regard for my grace.
translations.idiomatic: The State of Liang is my southern frontier dependency; when its ruler came to court, Chen secretly tried to entice him and showed no regard for my grace.

sentences.zh: 士女深迫脅之悲，城府致空虛之歎。

translations.literal: Scholars and women suffer the grief of forced oppression; frontier cities and districts echo with lament over emptiness.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars and women suffer the grief of forced oppression; frontier cities and districts echo with lament over emptiness.

sentences.zh: 非直朕居人上，懷此無忘，既而百辟屢以為言，兆庶不堪其請，豈容對而不誅，忍而不救！

translations.literal: It is not only that I, occupying the position above others, harbor this without forgetting — repeatedly the hundred officials have urged this upon me, and the myriad people cannot bear to plead any longer. How could I face this and not punish? Endure it and not rescue them!
translations.idiomatic: It is not only that I, occupying the position above others, harbor this without forgetting — repeatedly the hundred officials have urged this upon me, and the myriad people cannot bear to plead any longer. How could I face this and not punish? How could I endure it and not rescue them!

sentences.zh: 近日秋始，謀欲弔人。

translations.literal: Recently, as autumn began, I planned to comfort the people.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, as autumn began, I planned to comfort the people.

sentences.zh: 益部樓船，盡令東騖，便有神龍數十，騰躍江流，引伐罪之師，向金陵之路，船住則龍止，船行則龍去，四日之內，三軍皆覩，豈非蒼旻愛人，幽明展事，降神先路，協贊軍威！

translations.literal: The tower ships of Yizhou were all ordered eastward; then several tens of divine dragons leaped and soared upon the river currents, leading the army that would chastise guilt toward the road to Jinling — when the boats stopped the dragons stopped, when the boats moved the dragons departed; within four days the whole army witnessed it. Is this not Heaven loving the people, spirits and men revealing their intent, sending gods ahead to pave the way and joining to support military might!
translations.idiomatic: The tower ships of Yizhou were all ordered eastward; then several tens of divine dragons leaped and soared upon the river currents, leading the army that would chastise the guilty toward the road to Jinling — when the boats stopped the dragons stopped, when the boats moved the dragons departed. Within four days the whole army witnessed it. Is this not Heaven loving the people, spirits and men revealing their intent, sending gods ahead to pave the way and joining to support military might!

sentences.zh: 以上天之靈，助戡定之力，便可出師授律，應機誅殄，在斯舉也，永清吳、越。

translations.literal: With Heaven's numinous aid and force to pacify and settle, we may now dispatch the army and hand down the law, responding to the moment to destroy them — in this single action Wu and Yue will forever be cleared.
translations.idiomatic: With Heaven's numinous aid and the force to pacify and settle, we may now dispatch the army and hand down the law, responding to the moment to destroy them — in this single action Wu and Yue will forever be cleared.

sentences.zh: 其將士糧仗，水陸資須，期會進止，一準別勑。

translations.literal: As for rations and weapons for officers and soldiers, supplies for land and water, rendezvous, advance and halt — all shall follow separate edicts.
translations.idiomatic: As for rations and weapons for officers and soldiers, supplies for land and water, rendezvous, advance and halt — all shall follow separate edicts.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁未，河北諸州饑，遣吏部尚書蘇威賑恤之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on the day dingwei, the northern Hebei provinces suffered famine; Minister of Personnel Su Wei was dispatched to give relief.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, on the day dingwei, the northern Hebei provinces suffered famine; Minister of Personnel Su Wei was dispatched to give relief.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，宴南征諸將，頒賜各有差。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day dingchou, a banquet was held for the generals of the southern campaign and rewards were distributed according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day dingchou, a banquet was held for the generals of the southern campaign and rewards were distributed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，嘉州言龍見。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Jia Province reported a dragon sighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, Jia Province reported a dragon sighting.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，太白出西方。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jihai, the Bright Metal star appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jihai, the Bright Metal star appeared in the west.

sentences.zh: 己未，置淮南行臺省於壽春，以晉王廣為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, a provisional Branch Secretariat was established at Shouyang for the Huainan region; Prince of Jin Yang Guang was made Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, a provisional Branch Secretariat was established at Shouyang for the Huainan region; Prince of Jin Yang Guang was made Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，陳遣兼散騎常侍王琬、兼通直散騎常侍許善心來聘，拘留不遣。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Chen sent Acting Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Wang Wan and Acting Direct Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Xu Shanshan on a goodwill mission; they were detained and not sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, Chen sent Acting Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Wang Wan and Acting Direct Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Xu Shanshan on a goodwill mission; they were detained and not sent back.

sentences.zh: 甲子，將伐陳，有事於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, as the campaign against Chen was to begin, sacrifices were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, as the campaign against Chen was to begin, sacrifices were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 命晉王廣、秦王俊、清河公楊素並為行軍元帥，以伐陳。

translations.literal: Prince of Jin Yang Guang, Prince of Qin Yang Jun, and Duke of Qinghe Yang Su were all appointed supreme commanders of the campaign against Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jin Yang Guang, Prince of Qin Yang Jun, and Duke of Qinghe Yang Su were all appointed supreme commanders of the campaign against Chen.

sentences.zh: 於是晉王廣出六合，秦王俊出襄陽，清河公楊素出信州，荊州刺史劉仁恩出江陵，宜陽公王世積出蘄春，新義公韓擒虎出廬江，襄邑公賀若弼出吳州，落叢公燕榮出東海，合總管九十，兵五十一萬八千，皆受晉王節度。

translations.literal: Thereupon Yang Guang advanced from Liuhe, Yang Jun from Xiangyang, Yang Su from Xin Province, Governor of Jing Province Liu Ren'en from Jiangling, Duke of Yiyang Wang Shiji from Qichun, Duke of Xinyi Han Qihu from Lujiang, Duke of Xiangyi He Ruo from Wu Province, Duke of Luocong Yan Rong from the Eastern Sea — ninety commanders in all with 518,000 troops, all under Yang Guang's command.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Yang Guang advanced from Liuhe, Yang Jun from Xiangyang, Yang Su from Xin Province, Governor of Jing Province Liu Ren'en from Jiangling, Duke of Yiyang Wang Shiji from Qichun, Duke of Xinyi Han Qihu from Lujiang, Duke of Xiangyi He Ruo from Wu Province, and Duke of Luocong Yan Rong from the Eastern Sea — ninety commanders in all with 518,000 troops, all under Yang Guang's command.

sentences.zh: 東接滄海，西拒巴、蜀，旌旗舟楫，橫亘數千里。

translations.literal: Eastward they reached the eastern sea, westward they opposed Ba and Shu; banners and boats stretched across several thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward they reached the eastern sea, westward they opposed Ba and Shu; banners and boats stretched across several thousand li.

sentences.zh: 曲赦陳國。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was granted to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was granted to Chen.

sentences.zh: 有星孛于牽牛。

translations.literal: A comet appeared at the Ox constellation.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appeared at the Ox constellation.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，車駕餞師。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day dingmao, the emperor personally saw off the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day dingmao, the emperor personally saw off the army.

sentences.zh: 詔購陳叔寶位上柱國、萬戶公。

translations.literal: An edict offered a reward for Chen Shubao's head: the rank of Senior General of the First Rank and the title of Duke with ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: An edict offered a reward for Chen Shubao's head: the rank of Senior General of the First Rank and the title of Duke with ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，行幸定城，陳師誓眾。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the emperor traveled to Dingcheng; the Chen army rallied its troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, the emperor traveled to Dingcheng; the Chen army rallied its troops.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸河東。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the emperor went to Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, the emperor went to Hedong.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，至自河東。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengzi, the emperor returned from Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day gengzi, the emperor returned from Hedong.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月己巳，白虹夾日。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the ninth year, on the day jisi, a white rainbow flanked the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the ninth year, on the day jisi, a white rainbow flanked the sun.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賀若弼拔陳京口，韓擒虎拔陳南豫州。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, He Ruo captured Chen's Jingkou; Han Qihu captured Chen's Southern Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, He Ruo captured Chen's Jingkou; Han Qihu captured Chen's Southern Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以尚書右僕射虞慶則為右衞大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Yu Qingze, Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed General of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, Yu Qingze, Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed General of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賀若弼敗陳師於蔣山，獲其將蕭摩訶。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, He Ruo defeated Chen's army at Mount Jiang and captured its general Xiao Mohe.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, He Ruo defeated Chen's army at Mount Jiang and captured its general Xiao Mohe.

sentences.zh: 韓擒虎進師入建鄴，獲其將任蠻奴，[1]獲陳主叔寶。

translations.literal: Han Qihu pressed his army into Jiankang, capturing its general Ren Mannu,[1] and capturing Chen's ruler Chen Shubao.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qihu pressed his army into Jiankang, capturing its general Ren Mannu,[1] and capturing Chen's ruler Chen Shubao.

sentences.zh: 陳國平，合州三十，[2]郡一百，縣四百。

translations.literal: Chen was pacified, comprising thirty provinces, one hundred commanderies, and four hundred counties.
translations.idiomatic: Chen was pacified, comprising thirty provinces, one hundred commanderies, and four hundred counties.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，遣使持節巡撫之。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, envoys bearing credentials were dispatched to tour and reassure the region.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, envoys bearing credentials were dispatched to tour and reassure the region.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，廢淮南行臺省。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yiwei, the provisional Huainan Branch Secretariat was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day yiwei, the provisional Huainan Branch Secretariat was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙申，制五百家為鄉，正一人；

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, a regulation was issued: five hundred households form a district, with one district chief;
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen, a regulation was issued: five hundred households form a district, with one district chief;

sentences.zh: 百家為里，長一人。

translations.literal: one hundred households form a lane, with one lane chief.
translations.idiomatic: one hundred households form a lane, with one lane chief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以襄州總管韋世康為安州總管。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Wei Shikang, Commander-in-Chief of Xiang Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of An Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, Wei Shikang, Commander-in-Chief of Xiang Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of An Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，幸驪山，親勞旋師。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jihai, the emperor traveled to Mount Li and personally welcomed the returning army.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jihai, the emperor traveled to Mount Li and personally welcomed the returning army.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，三軍凱入，獻俘於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the triumphant army entered the capital and presented captives at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, the triumphant army entered the capital and presented captives at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 拜晉王廣為太尉。

translations.literal: Prince of Jin Yang Guang was appointed Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jin Yang Guang was appointed Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上御廣陽門，宴將士，頒賜各有差。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the emperor ascended Guangyang Gate, banquetted the officers and soldiers, and distributed rewards according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu, the emperor ascended Guangyang Gate, banquetted the officers and soldiers, and distributed rewards according to rank.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己未，以陳都官尚書孔範，散騎常侍王瑳、王儀，御史中丞沈觀等，邪佞於其主，以致亡滅，皆投之邊裔。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Kong Fan, Minister of Justice of Chen, Wang Shao and Wang Yi, Attendants-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue, and Vice Censor-in-Chief Shen Guan and others, who had been wicked and flatterers to their ruler and thereby brought about ruin, were all sent to the remote borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, Kong Fan, Minister of Justice of Chen, Wang Shao and Wang Yi, Attendants-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue, and Vice Censor-in-Chief Shen Guan and others — wicked flatterers to their ruler who thereby brought about ruin — were all sent to the remote borderlands.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以信州總管楊素為荊州總管，吏部侍郎宇文㢸為刑部尚書，宗正少卿楊异為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Yang Su, Commander-in-Chief of Xin Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province; Yu Wen Bi, Vice Minister of Personnel, was appointed Minister of Justice; Yang Yi, Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court, was appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, Yang Su, Commander-in-Chief of Xin Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province; Yu Wen Bi, Vice Minister of Personnel, was appointed Minister of Justice; Yang Yi, Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court, was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔曰：

translations.literal: On the day renchen, an edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, an edict stated:

sentences.zh: 往以吳、越之野，羣黎塗炭，干戈方用，積習未寧。

translations.literal: Formerly in the lands of Wu and Yue the multitudes were battered in hardship; weapons were just then in use, and deep habits had not been settled.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly in the lands of Wu and Yue the multitudes were battered in hardship; weapons were just then in use, and deep habits had not been settled.

sentences.zh: 今率土大同，含生遂性，太平之法，方可流行。

translations.literal: Now the whole realm is united; all living beings follow their nature; the laws of peace and order may at last be put into practice.
translations.idiomatic: Now the whole realm is united; all living beings follow their nature; the laws of peace and order may at last be put into practice.

sentences.zh: 凡我臣僚，澡身浴德，開通耳目，宜從茲始。

translations.literal: All my officials — cleanse body and cultivate virtue, open ears and eyes; this should begin from now.
translations.idiomatic: All my officials — cleanse body and cultivate virtue, open ears and eyes; this should begin from now.

sentences.zh: 喪亂已來，緬將十載，君無君德，臣失臣道，父有不慈，子有不孝，兄弟之情或薄，夫婦之義或違，長幼失序，尊卑錯亂。

translations.literal: Since the age of chaos and ruin, nearly ten years have nearly passed: rulers lacked the virtue of rulers, ministers lost the way of ministers; fathers were unkind, sons unfilial; brotherly affection sometimes grew thin, conjugal duty sometimes was broken; elders and juniors lost proper order, high and low were confused.
translations.idiomatic: Since the age of chaos and ruin, nearly ten years have passed: rulers lacked the virtue of rulers, ministers lost the way of ministers; fathers were unkind, sons unfilial; brotherly affection sometimes grew thin, conjugal duty sometimes was broken; elders and juniors lost proper order, high and low were confused.

sentences.zh: 朕為帝王，志存愛養，時有臻道，不敢寧息。

translations.literal: I as emperor am resolved on cherishing and nurturing the people; whenever there is a path to attain the Way, I dare not rest in ease.
translations.idiomatic: I as emperor am resolved on cherishing and nurturing the people; whenever there is a path to attain the Way, I dare not rest in ease.

sentences.zh: 內外職位，遐邇黎人，家家自修，人人克念，使不軌不法，蕩然俱盡。

translations.literal: Inside and outside, in every office, near and far among the common people — let every household cultivate itself, every person keep the Way in mind, so that all that is irregular and unlawful may be swept away entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Inside and outside, in every office, near and far among the common people — let every household cultivate itself, every person keep the Way in mind, so that all that is irregular and unlawful may be swept away entirely.

sentences.zh: 兵可立威，不可不戢，刑可助化，不可專行。

translations.literal: Arms may establish awe, but cannot fail to be sheathed; punishments may assist in transformation, but cannot be applied exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: Arms may establish awe, but cannot fail to be sheathed; punishments may assist in transformation, but cannot be applied exclusively.

sentences.zh: 禁衞九重之餘，鎮守四方之外，戎旅軍器，皆宜停罷。

translations.literal: Beyond the ninefold inner palaces, at the garrison posts guarding the four quarters, military travel and weapons should all be halted and disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the ninefold inner palaces, at the garrison posts guarding the four quarters, military travel and weapons should all be halted and disbanded.

sentences.zh: 代路既夷，羣方無事，武力之子，俱可學文，人間甲仗，悉皆除毀。

translations.literal: Now that the routes of the age are level, the regions have no affairs; men of martial force may all study letters; all armor and weapons among the people should be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the routes of the age are level and the regions have no affairs, men of martial force may all study letters; all armor and weapons among the people should be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 有功之臣，降情文藝，家門子姪，各守一經，令海內翕然，高山仰止。

translations.literal: Ministers who achieved merit should lower their martial pride and take up the arts; sons and nephews of noble houses should each keep to one classic, until within the realm all look up in harmony to a high peak.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers who achieved merit should lower their martial pride and take up the arts; sons and nephews of noble houses should each keep to one classic, until within the realm all look up in harmony to a high peak.

sentences.zh: 京邑庠序，爰及州縣，生徒受業，升進於朝，未有灼然明經高第。

translations.literal: In the capital's schools, and extending to the provinces and counties, students receiving instruction should advance to court — yet there have been no clearly outstanding graduates who mastered the classics and ranked at the top.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital's schools, and extending to the provinces and counties, students receiving instruction should advance to court — yet there have been no clearly outstanding graduates who mastered the classics and ranked at the top.

sentences.zh: 此則教訓不篤，考課未精，明勒所由，隆茲儒訓。

translations.literal: This means instruction has not been earnest and examination has not been rigorous; clearly decree the means by which to exalt Confucian teaching.
translations.idiomatic: This means instruction has not been earnest and examination has not been rigorous; clearly decree the means by which to exalt Confucian teaching.

sentences.zh: 官府從宦，丘園素士，心迹相表，寬弘為念，勿為跼促，乖我皇猷。

translations.literal: Those in office and those serving from home, in hills and gardens — whether in heart or in conduct they show themselves; keep broadness in mind, do not be cramped and narrow, and do not betray my imperial design.
translations.idiomatic: Those in office and those serving from home, in hills and gardens — whether in heart or in conduct they show themselves; keep broadness in mind, do not be cramped and narrow, and do not betray my imperial design.

sentences.zh: 朕君臨區宇，於茲九載，開直言之路，披不諱之心，形於顏色，勞於興寢。

translations.literal: I have ruled the realm now for nine years, opening the road to blunt speech and laying bare a heart that hides nothing; this shows on my face and wears upon my rising and sleeping.
translations.idiomatic: I have ruled the realm now for nine years, opening the road to blunt speech and laying bare a heart that hides nothing; this shows on my face and wears upon my rising and sleeping.

sentences.zh: 自頃逞藝論功，昌言乃眾，推誠切諫，其事甚疎。

translations.literal: Recently, when people vaunt their skills and discuss merit, boastful words are many; sincere and earnest remonstrance is very rare.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, when people vaunt their skills and discuss merit, boastful words are many; sincere and earnest remonstrance is very rare.

sentences.zh: 公卿士庶，非所望也，各啟至誠，匡茲不逮。

translations.literal: This is not what I expect of dukes, ministers, scholars, and commoners; each should bring forth utmost sincerity to correct what I have not yet achieved.
translations.idiomatic: This is not what I expect of dukes, ministers, scholars, and commoners; each should bring forth utmost sincerity to correct what I have not yet achieved.

sentences.zh: 見善必進，有才必舉，無或噤默，退有後言。

translations.literal: When you see good, advance it; when there is talent, promote it; do not hold silent and then speak ill afterward.
translations.idiomatic: When you see good, advance it; when there is talent, promote it; do not hold silent and then speak ill afterward.

sentences.zh: 頒告天下，咸悉此意。

translations.literal: Proclaim this throughout the realm so all may understand this intent.
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim this throughout the realm so all may understand this intent.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲子，以安州總管韋世康為信州總管。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiazi, Wei Shikang, Commander-in-Chief of An Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Xin Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the day jiazi, Wei Shikang, Commander-in-Chief of An Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Xin Province.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，頒木魚符於於總管、刺史，雌一雄一。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, wooden fish tally tokens were issued to commanders-in-chief and prefects, one female and one male.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, wooden fish tally tokens were issued to commanders-in-chief and prefects, one female and one male.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以吏部尚書蘇威為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Su Wei, Minister of Personnel, was appointed Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, Su Wei, Minister of Personnel, was appointed Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，以荊州總管楊素為納言。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yichou, Yang Su, Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province, was appointed Chief Adviser to the Throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day yichou, Yang Su, Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province, was appointed Chief Adviser to the Throne.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以吏部侍郎盧愷為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Lu Kai, Vice Minister of Personnel, was appointed Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, Lu Kai, Vice Minister of Personnel, was appointed Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 時朝野物議，咸願登封。

translations.literal: At that time, in court and countryside alike, public discussion unanimously favored performing the feng and shan rites.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, opinion throughout court and countryside alike favored holding the feng and shan rites.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，詔曰：「豈可命一將軍，除一小國，遐邇注意，便謂太平。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day bingwu, an edict stated: "How can one, by ordering a single general to subdue a small state, with attention fixed near and far, at once declare the age at peace?"
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day bingwu, an edict stated: "How can one, by ordering a single general to subdue a small state, with all eyes near and far upon us, at once declare the age at peace?"

sentences.zh: 以薄德而封名山，用虛言而干上帝，非朕攸聞。

translations.literal: With meager virtue to ascend the sacred mountains, and with empty words to importune High Heaven — this is not what I have heard of.
translations.idiomatic: To ascend the sacred mountains with meager virtue, and to importune High Heaven with empty words — this is not what I have heard of.

sentences.zh: 而今以後，言及封禪，宜即禁絕。」

translations.literal: Henceforth, whenever feng and shan are mentioned, it should at once be forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, whenever feng and shan are mentioned, it shall at once be forbidden."

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌，以廣平王雄為司空。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day renxu, Prince of Guangping Yang Xiong was appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day renxu, Prince of Guangping Yang Xiong was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬辰，考使定州刺史豆盧通等上表，請封禪，上不許。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day renchen, the inspection commissioners led by Prefect of Ding Province Dou Lu Tong and others submitted a memorial requesting the feng and shan rites; the emperor did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day renchen, the inspection commissioners led by Prefect of Ding Province Dou Lu Tong and others submitted a memorial requesting the feng and shan rites; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以右衞大將軍虞慶則為右武候大將軍，右領軍將軍李安為右領軍大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Yu Qingze, General of the Right Guard, was appointed General of the Right Martial Guard; Li An, General of the Right Rear Guard, was appointed General of the Right Rear Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, Yu Qingze, General of the Right Guard, was appointed General of the Right Martial Guard; Li An, General of the Right Rear Guard, was appointed General of the Right Rear Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，降囚徒。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, convicts were granted reduction of sentence.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, convicts were granted reduction of sentence.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，詔曰：「朕祗承天命，清蕩萬方。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiazi, an edict stated: "I reverently receive Heaven's Mandate and have cleared and pacified the ten thousand regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day jiazi, an edict stated: "I reverently receive Heaven's Mandate and have cleared and pacified the ten thousand regions.

sentences.zh: 百王衰敝之後，兆庶澆浮之日，聖人遺訓，掃地俱盡，制禮作樂，今也其時。

translations.literal: After the hundred kings' age of decay, in days when the myriad people are shallow and adrift, the sages' legacy has been swept clean to the ground; to establish rites and create music — now is the time.
translations.idiomatic: After the hundred kings' age of decay, in days when the myriad people are shallow and adrift, the sages' legacy has been swept clean to the ground. To establish rites and create music — now is the time.

sentences.zh: 朕情存古樂，深思雅道。

translations.literal: My heart preserves the ancient music and deeply ponders the elegant Way.
translations.idiomatic: My heart preserves the ancient music and deeply ponders the elegant Way.

sentences.zh: 鄭、衞淫聲，魚龍雜戲，樂府之內，盡以除之。

translations.literal: The licentious sounds of Zheng and Wei, and the mixed entertainments of fish and dragon — within the Music Office all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The licentious sounds of Zheng and Wei, and the mixed entertainments of fish and dragon — within the Music Office all were abolished.

sentences.zh: 今欲更調律呂，改張琴瑟。

translations.literal: Now I wish to retune the pitch pipes and restring the zithers and lutes.
translations.idiomatic: Now I wish to retune the pitch pipes and restring the zithers and lutes.

sentences.zh: 且妙術精微，非因教習，工人代掌，止傳糟粕，不足達神明之德，論天地之和。

translations.literal: Moreover, subtle arts are profound and cannot be mastered without instruction; when craftsmen pass them down by rote, they transmit only dregs — insufficient to reach the virtue of the numinous or discuss the harmony of Heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, these subtle arts are profound and cannot be mastered without instruction. When craftsmen pass them down by rote, they transmit only dregs — insufficient to reach the virtue of the numinous or discuss the harmony of Heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 區域之間，奇才異藝，天知神授，何代無哉！

translations.literal: Within the realm, men of rare talent and extraordinary skill, Heaven-knowing and spirit-endowed — what age has lacked them!
translations.idiomatic: Within the realm, men of rare talent and extraordinary skill, Heaven-knowing and spirit-endowed — what age has lacked them!

sentences.zh: 蓋晦迹於非時，俟昌言於所好，宜可搜訪，速以奏聞，庶覩一藝之能，共就九成之業。

translations.literal: They have merely hidden their traces in unpropitious times, awaiting a clear summons to what they love; they should be sought out and quickly reported, so that we may witness each man's single art and together complete the work of the Nine Accomplishments.
translations.idiomatic: They have merely hidden their traces in unpropitious times, awaiting a clear summons to what they love. They should be sought out and quickly reported, so that we may witness each man's single art and together complete the work of the Nine Accomplishments.

sentences.zh: 」仍詔太常牛弘、通直散騎常侍許善心、祕書丞姚察、通直郎虞世基等議定作樂。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict ordered Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Niu Hong, Direct Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Xu Shanshan, Secretariat Assistant Director Yao Cha, and Attendant Gentleman Yu Shiji and others to deliberate and establish the music.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon an edict ordered Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Niu Hong, Direct Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Loose Retinue Xu Shanshan, Secretariat Assistant Director Yao Cha, and Attendant Gentleman Yu Shiji and others to deliberate and establish the music.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以黃州總管周法尚為永州總管。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Zhou Fashang, Commander-in-Chief of Huang Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi, Zhou Fashang, Commander-in-Chief of Huang Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月乙未，以皇孫昭為河南王，楷為華陽王。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on the day yiwei, the emperor's grandsons Zhao and Kai were enfeoffed as Prince of Henan and Prince of Huayang respectively.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on the day yiwei, the emperor's grandsons Zhao and Kai were enfeoffed as Prince of Henan and Prince of Huayang respectively.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，幸并州。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengshen, the emperor traveled to Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day gengshen, the emperor traveled to Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉，至自并州。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day xinyou, the emperor returned from Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the day xinyou, the emperor returned from Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，詔曰：「魏末喪亂，宇縣瓜分，役車歲動，未遑休息。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day yiwei, an edict stated: "At the end of Wei, amid chaos and ruin, the realm was carved up; war chariots moved year after year, with no leisure to rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day yiwei, an edict stated: "At the end of Wei, amid chaos and ruin, the realm was carved up. War chariots moved year after year, with no leisure to rest.

sentences.zh: 兵士軍人，權置坊府，南征北伐，居處無定。

translations.literal: Soldiers and military men were provisionally placed in garrison offices; campaigning south and north, they had no fixed abode.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and military men were provisionally placed in garrison offices; campaigning south and north, they had no fixed abode.

sentences.zh: 家無完堵，地罕包桑，恒為流寓之人，竟無鄉里之號。

translations.literal: No household had intact walls, and few fields had mulberry enclosures; they were constantly people adrift, and in the end had no name of native district.
translations.idiomatic: No household had intact walls, and few fields had mulberry enclosures. They were constantly people adrift, and in the end had no name of native district.

sentences.zh: 朕甚愍之。

translations.literal: I deeply pity them.
translations.idiomatic: I deeply pity them.

sentences.zh: 凡是軍人，可悉屬州縣，墾田籍帳，一與民同。

translations.literal: All military men may entirely be assigned to provinces and counties, cultivating fields and entered in registers, the same as common people.
translations.idiomatic: All military men shall be assigned to provinces and counties, cultivating fields and entered in registers, the same as common people.

sentences.zh: 軍府統領，宜依舊式。

translations.literal: The military offices' command should follow the old pattern.
translations.idiomatic: The military offices' command should follow the old pattern.

sentences.zh: 罷山東河南及北方緣邊之地新置軍府。」

translations.literal: Abolish the newly established military offices in Shandong, Henan, and the northern frontier regions."
translations.idiomatic: Abolish the newly established military offices in Shandong, Henan, and the northern frontier regions."

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，制人年五十，免役收庸。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinyou, a regulation was issued: at age fifty a person was exempted from corvée and could pay substitute labor instead.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day xinyou, a regulation was issued: at age fifty a person was exempted from corvée and could pay substitute labor instead.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以靈州總管王世積為荊州總管，淅州刺史元冑為靈州總管。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Wang Shiji, Commander-in-Chief of Ling Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province; Yuan Zhou, Prefect of Xi Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Ling Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Wang Shiji, Commander-in-Chief of Ling Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province; Yuan Zhou, Prefect of Xi Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Ling Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯，以納言楊素為內史令。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day guimao, Yang Su, Chief Adviser to the Throne, was appointed Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day guimao, Yang Su, Chief Adviser to the Throne, was appointed Director of the Secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: I received the Mandate from High Heaven and cleared and pacified the realm. The numinous spirits extended their aid, and civil and military officials were of one mind.

sentences.zh: 申明公穆、鄖襄公孝寬、廣平王雄、蔣國公睿、楚國公勣、齊國公熲、越國公素、魯國公慶則、新寧公長叉、宜陽公世積、趙國公羅雲、隴西公詢、廣業公景、真昌公振、沛國公譯、項城公子相、鉅鹿公子幹等，登庸納揆之時，草昧經綸之日，丹誠大節，心盡帝圖，茂績殊勳，力宣王府。

translations.literal: Marquis Shenming Duke Mu, Duke of Yun and Xiang Li Xiaowan, Prince of Guangping Yang Xiong, Duke of Jiang Yang Rui, Duke of Chu Dou Lu Ji, Duke of Qi Gao Jiong, Duke of Yue Yang Su, Duke of Lu Yu Qingze, Duke of Xining Yang Changcha, Duke of Yiyang Wang Shiji, Duke of Zhao Yang Luoyun, Duke of Longxi Li Xun, Duke of Guangye Yang Jing, Duke of Zhenchang Yang Zhen, Duke of Pei Zheng Yi, Duke of Xiangcheng Yang Zixiang, Duke of Julu Helou Zigan, and others — at the time they entered office and assumed governance, in the days of founding when the realm was still in disorder, they showed red loyalty and great constancy, their hearts exhausting themselves for the imperial design, with splendid achievements and extraordinary merit, exerting strength to proclaim the royal house.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Shenming Duke Mu, Duke of Yun and Xiang Li Xiaowan, Prince of Guangping Yang Xiong, Duke of Jiang Yang Rui, Duke of Chu Dou Lu Ji, Duke of Qi Gao Jiong, Duke of Yue Yang Su, Duke of Lu Yu Qingze, Duke of Xining Yang Changcha, Duke of Yiyang Wang Shiji, Duke of Zhao Yang Luoyun, Duke of Longxi Li Xun, Duke of Guangye Yang Jing, Duke of Zhenchang Yang Zhen, Duke of Pei Zheng Yi, Duke of Xiangcheng Yang Zixiang, Duke of Julu Helou Zigan, and others — at the time they entered office and assumed governance, in the days of founding when the realm was still in disorder, showed red loyalty and great constancy, exhausting their hearts for the imperial design, with splendid achievements and extraordinary merit, exerting strength to proclaim the royal house.

sentences.zh: 宜弘其門緒，與國同休。

translations.literal: Their lineages should be enlarged to share blessing with the state.
translations.idiomatic: Their lineages should be enlarged to share blessing with the state.

sentences.zh: 其世子世孫未經州任者，宜量才升用，庶享榮位，世祿無窮。」

translations.literal: Their heir sons and heir grandsons who have not yet held provincial appointments should be promoted according to talent, so that they may enjoy honored rank and endless hereditary stipends."
translations.idiomatic: Their heir sons and heir grandsons who have not yet held provincial appointments should be promoted according to talent, so that they may enjoy honored rank and endless hereditary stipends."

sentences.zh: 五月，宴百僚於玉女泉，頒賜各有差。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, a banquet was held for the hundred officials at Jade Maiden Spring and rewards were distributed according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, a banquet was held for the hundred officials at Jade Maiden Spring and rewards were distributed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 己巳，蜀王秀來朝。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Prince of Shu Yang Xiu came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi, Prince of Shu Yang Xiu came to court.

sentences.zh: 高麗遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以左衞將軍獨孤羅雲為涼州總管。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Dugu Luoyun, General of the Left Guard, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu, Dugu Luoyun, General of the Left Guard, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Liang Province.

translations.literal: [14] Scholarly annotation marker.
translations.idiomatic: [14] Scholarly annotation marker.

sentences.zh: 閏月己卯，羣鹿入殿門，馴擾侍衞之內。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jimao, a herd of deer entered the palace gate and tamely wandered within the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the day jimao, a herd of deer entered the palace gate and tamely wandered within the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，桂州人李代賢反，[15]遣右武候大將軍虞慶則討平之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day dingchou, Li Daixian of Gui Province rebelled;[15] Yu Qingze, General of the Right Martial Guard, was dispatched to suppress and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day dingchou, Li Daixian of Gui Province rebelled;[15] Yu Qingze, General of the Right Martial Guard, was dispatched to suppress and pacify him.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上柱國、并州總管秦王俊坐事免，以王就第。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Senior General of the First Rank and Commander-in-Chief of Bing Province Yang Jun was dismissed for an offense and sent to his residence as a prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, Senior General of the First Rank and Commander-in-Chief of Bing Province Yang Jun was dismissed for an offense and sent to his residence as a prince.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，突厥遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the Turks sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, the Turks sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，荊州總管、上庸郡公韋世康卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingmao, Wei Shikang, Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province and Duke of Shangyong, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day dingmao, Wei Shikang, Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province and Duke of Shangyong, died.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，至自仁壽宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiashen, the emperor returned from Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jiashen, the emperor returned from Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上謂侍臣曰：「禮主於敬，皆當盡心。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the emperor said to his attending ministers: "Rites are rooted in reverence, and all should give their full hearts.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, the emperor said to his attending ministers: "Rites are rooted in reverence, and all should give their full hearts.

sentences.zh: 黍稷非馨，貴在祗肅。

translations.literal: Millet and millet are not fragrant in themselves; what is precious is reverent solemnity.
translations.idiomatic: Millet and millet are not fragrant in themselves; what is precious is reverent solemnity.

sentences.zh: 廟庭設樂，本以迎神，齋祭之日，觸目多感。

translations.literal: Music is set up in the temple courtyard originally to welcome the spirits; on days of fasting sacrifice, what meets the eye moves one deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Music is set up in the temple courtyard originally to welcome the spirits; on days of fasting sacrifice, what meets the eye moves one deeply.

sentences.zh: 當此之際，何可為心！

translations.literal: At such a moment, how can one compose one's heart!
translations.idiomatic: At such a moment, how can the heart be at ease!

sentences.zh: 在路奏樂，禮未為允。

translations.literal: To perform music on the road is not permitted by ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Playing music along the road is not ritually acceptable.

sentences.zh: 羣公卿士，宜更詳之。」

translations.literal: Dukes, ministers, and scholars should examine this further."
translations.idiomatic: The assembled dukes, ministers, and scholars should examine this matter further."

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，頒銅獸符於驃騎、車騎府。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day dingwei, bronze beast tally tokens were issued to the Rapid Cavalry and Chariot Cavalry offices.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the day dingwei, bronze beast tally tokens were issued to the Rapid Cavalry and Chariot Cavalry offices.

sentences.zh: [16]戊申，道王靜薨。

translations.literal: [16] On the day wushen, Prince of Dao Yang Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: [16] On the day wushen, Prince of Dao Yang Jing died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔曰：「五帝異樂，三王殊禮，皆隨事而有損益，因情而立節文。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, an edict stated: "The Five Emperors had different music, the Three Kings had different rites — all were adjusted according to circumstances and established in ritual form according to feeling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, an edict stated: "The Five Emperors had different music and the Three Kings had different rites — each adjusted according to circumstance and shaped ritual form to fit the feeling of the age.

sentences.zh: 仰惟祭享宗廟，瞻敬如在，罔極之感，情深茲日。

translations.literal: When one looks up to sacrifice and offer to the Ancestral Temple, reverence is as though the spirits were present; the feeling of boundless gratitude runs deepest on this day.
translations.idiomatic: When one looks up to sacrifice at the Ancestral Temple, reverence is as though the spirits were present; on this day the feeling of boundless gratitude runs deepest.

sentences.zh: 而禮畢升路，鼓吹發音，還入宮門，金石振響。

translations.literal: Yet when the rites are complete and one mounts the carriage, drums and pipes sound; upon returning through the palace gate, bells and stones resound.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when the rites are finished and one mounts the carriage, drums and pipes sound; upon re-entering the palace gate, bells and chimes resound.

sentences.zh: 斯則哀樂同日，心事相違，情所不安，理實未允。

translations.literal: Thus mourning and music fall on the same day; the heart's intent and the outward act are at odds — what the feelings cannot accept is in truth not permitted by reason.
translations.idiomatic: Thus grief and music fall on the same day, and the heart's intent conflicts with the outward act — what feeling cannot accept is in truth not permitted by reason.

sentences.zh: 宜改茲往式，用弘禮教。

translations.literal: The former practice should be changed to extend ritual teaching.
translations.idiomatic: The former practice should be changed so as to extend ritual teaching.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，享廟日不須備鼓吹，殿庭勿設樂懸。

translations.literal: From this time forward, on days of temple offerings drums and pipes need not be provided, and bell frames should not be set up in the palace hall.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, on days of temple offerings drums and pipes need not be provided, and bell frames should not be set up in the palace hall.

sentences.zh: 」辛未，京師大索。

translations.literal: " On the day xinwei, a great search was conducted in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: " On the day xinwei, a great search was conducted in the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，突厥遣使來朝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day dinghai, the Turks sent envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day dinghai, the Turks sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，上柱國、右武候大將軍、魯國公虞慶則以罪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renzi, Senior General of the First Rank, General of the Right Martial Guard, and Duke of Lu Guo Yu Qingze was executed for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day renzi, Senior General of the First Rank, General of the Right Martial Guard, and Duke of Lu Guo Yu Qingze was executed for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月辛丑，詔曰：「吳、越之人，往承弊俗，所在之處，私造大船，因相聚結，致有侵害。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the eighteenth year, on the day xinchou, an edict stated: "The people of Wu and Yue have long inherited corrupt customs; wherever they are, they privately build large boats, gather together, and cause harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the eighteenth year, on the day xinchou, an edict stated: "The people of Wu and Yue have long inherited corrupt customs; wherever they dwell they privately build large boats, gather in bands, and cause harm.

sentences.zh: 其江南諸州，人間有船長三丈已上，悉括入官。」

translations.literal: In all the southern provinces, any boat among the people longer than three zhang shall be confiscated by the state."
translations.idiomatic: In all the Jiangnan provinces, any boat among the people longer than three zhang shall be confiscated by the state."

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，幸仁壽宮。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiachen, the emperor visited Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day jiachen, the emperor visited Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以漢王諒為行軍元帥，水陸三十萬伐高麗。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Prince of Han Yang Liang was made Campaign Commander-in-Chief, and three hundred thousand troops by land and water were sent to attack Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, Prince of Han Yang Liang was made Campaign Commander-in-Chief, and three hundred thousand troops by land and water were sent to attack Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，以柱國杜彥為朔州總管。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day yihai, Senior General Du Yan was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day yihai, Senior General Du Yan was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，以蔣州刺史郭衍為洪州總管。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day guimao, Guo Yan, Prefect of Jiang Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Hong Province.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the day guimao, Guo Yan, Prefect of Jiang Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Hong Province.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，[17]詔畜猫鬼、蠱毒、厭魅、野道之家，投於四裔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinhai, [17] an edict ordered that households keeping cat-demons, poison sorcery, malign charms, and wild cults be banished to the four borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day xinhai, [17] an edict ordered that households practicing cat-demon sorcery, poison witchcraft, malign charms, or wild cults be banished to the four borderlands.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，下詔黜高麗王高元官爵。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingyin, an edict was issued stripping King Gao Yuan of Goguryeo of his titles and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day bingyin, an edict was issued stripping King Gao Yuan of Goguryeo of his titles and ranks.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，詔以河南八州水，免其課役。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day renshen, an edict granted exemption from taxes and corvée to the eight Henan provinces on account of flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day renshen, an edict granted exemption from taxes and corvée to the eight Henan provinces on account of flooding.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔京官五品已上，總管、刺史，以志行修謹、清平幹濟二科舉人。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, an edict ordered that capital officials of the fifth rank and above, commanders-in-chief, and prefects recommend candidates under the two categories of "upright conduct and careful cultivation" and "clear and fair with practical ability."
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, an edict ordered that capital officials of the fifth rank and above, commanders-in-chief, and prefects recommend men under the two categories of "upright conduct and careful cultivation" and "clear, fair, and capable in office."

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，漢王諒師遇疾疫而旋，死者十八九。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jichou, Prince of Han Yang Liang's army encountered plague and withdrew; eight or nine out of ten died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jichou, Prince of Han Yang Liang's army met with plague and withdrew; eight or nine out of ten perished.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，勑舍客無公驗者，坐及刺史、縣令。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, an imperial order stated that lodging guests without official travel documents would implicate the prefect and county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, an imperial order stated that lodging guests without official travel documents would implicate the prefect and county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，至自仁壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the emperor returned from Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, the emperor returned from Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲戌，上親錄囚徒。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day jiaxu, the emperor personally reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day jiaxu, the emperor personally reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 癸未，有事於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, sacrifices were performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, sacrifices were performed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，上柱國、夏州總管、任城郡公王景以罪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengzi, Senior General of the First Rank, Commander-in-Chief of Xia Province, and Duke of Rencheng Wang Jing was executed for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day gengzi, Senior General of the First Rank, Commander-in-Chief of Xia Province, and Duke of Rencheng Wang Jing was executed for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 是月，自京師至仁壽宮，置行宮十有二所。

translations.literal: That month, twelve traveling palaces were established from the capital to Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That month, twelve traveling palaces were established from the capital to Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月癸酉，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the nineteenth year, on the day guiyou, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the nineteenth year, on the day guiyou, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，大射武德殿，宴賜百官。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, archery was performed at Wude Hall, and a banquet was held with rewards distributed to the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, archery was performed at Wude Hall, and a banquet was held with rewards distributed to the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，晉王廣來朝。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jihai, Prince of Jin Yang Guang came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day jihai, Prince of Jin Yang Guang came to court.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以并州總管長史宇文㢸為朔州總管。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Yu Wen Bi, Chief Administrator of Bing Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, Yu Wen Bi, Chief Administrator of Bing Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸仁壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the emperor visited Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, the emperor visited Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，突厥利可汗內附。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day dingyou, the Turkish Li Khan submitted to the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the day dingyou, the Turkish Li Khan submitted to the dynasty.

sentences.zh: [18]達頭可汗犯塞，遣行軍總管史萬歲擊破之。

translations.literal: [18] The Tardu Khan raided the frontier; Campaign Commander-in-Chief Shi Wansui was dispatched and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: [18] The Tardu Khan raided the frontier; Campaign Commander-in-Chief Shi Wansui was dispatched, defeated him, and drove him back.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，以豫章王暕為內史令。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingyou, Prince of Yuzhang Yang Zhan was appointed Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day dingyou, Prince of Yuzhang Yang Zhan was appointed Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸卯，上柱國、尚書左僕射、齊國公高熲坐事免。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on the day guimao, Senior General of the First Rank, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Duke of Qi Gao Jiong was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, on the day guimao, Senior General of the First Rank, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Duke of Qi Gao Jiong was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上柱國、皖城郡公張威卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Senior General of the First Rank and Duke of Wancheng Zhang Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, Senior General of the First Rank and Duke of Wancheng Zhang Wei died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅、上柱國、城陽郡公李徹卒。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Senior General of the First Rank and Duke of Chengyang Li Che died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, Senior General of the First Rank and Duke of Chengyang Li Che died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，以太常卿牛弘為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yichou, Niu Hong, Minister of Ceremonies, was appointed Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day yichou, Niu Hong, Minister of Ceremonies, was appointed Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，以突厥利可汗為啟人可汗，[19]築大利城處其部落。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiawu, the Turkish Li Khan was made Qiren Khan, [19] and the city of Dali was built to settle his tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiawu, the Turkish Li Khan was made Qiren Khan, [19] and the city of Dali was built to receive his tribes.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以朔州總管宇文㢸為代州總管。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Yu Wen Bi, Commander-in-Chief of Shuozhou, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Dai Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, Yu Wen Bi, Commander-in-Chief of Shuozhou, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Dai Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，突厥都藍可汗為部下所殺。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yiwei, the Turkish Dulan Khan was killed by his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day yiwei, the Turkish Dulan Khan was killed by his subordinates.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，[20]星隕於勃海。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, [20] a star fell in the Bohai Sea.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, [20] a star fell in the Bohai Sea.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月辛酉朔，上在仁壽宮。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, on the first day xinyou, the emperor was at Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, on the first day xinyou, the emperor was at Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 突厥、高麗、契丹並遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: The Turks, Goguryeo, and Khitan all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks, Goguryeo, and Khitan all sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以代州總管宇文㢸為吳州總管。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Yu Wen Bi, Commander-in-Chief of Dai Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Wu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Yu Wen Bi, Commander-in-Chief of Dai Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Wu Province.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，以上柱國崔弘度為原州總管。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jisi, Senior General of the First Rank Cui Hongdu was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yuan Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day jisi, Senior General of the First Rank Cui Hongdu was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yuan Province.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，無雲而雷。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, thunder sounded though there were no clouds.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, thunder sounded though there were no clouds.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，熙州人李英林反，遣行軍總管張衡討平之。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, an edict stated: "The Buddhist Law is profound and subtle; the Daoist Way is empty yet penetrating — both descend with great compassion to deliver all beings; all who possess consciousness receive their sheltering protection.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, an edict stated: "The Buddhist Law is profound and subtle; the Daoist Way is empty yet penetrating — both descend in great compassion to deliver all beings, and all who possess consciousness receive their sheltering protection.

sentences.zh: 所以雕鑄靈相，圖寫真形，率土瞻仰，用申誠敬。

translations.literal: Therefore spirit images are cast and true forms painted, so that throughout the land people may look up and express sincere reverence.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason spirit images are cast and true forms painted, so that throughout the land people may look up and express sincere reverence.

sentences.zh: 其五嶽四鎮，節宣雲雨，江、河、淮、海，浸潤區域，並生養萬物，利益兆人，故建廟立祀，以時恭敬。

translations.literal: The Five Sacred Peaks and Four Guardian Mountains regulate clouds and rain; the Yangzi, Yellow, Huai, and sea rivers moisten the regions — all nourish the myriad things and benefit the people; therefore temples and sacrifices are established to offer timely reverence.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Sacred Peaks and Four Guardian Mountains regulate clouds and rain; the Yangzi, Yellow, Huai, and sea rivers moisten the regions — all nourish the myriad things and benefit the people; therefore temples and sacrifices are established so that reverence may be offered in season.

sentences.zh: 敢有毀壞偷盜佛及天尊像、嶽鎮海瀆神形者，以不道論。

translations.literal: Whoever dares destroy, steal, or damage images of Buddha or the Heavenly Worthy, or the spirit forms of the peaks, guardian mountains, and rivers and seas, shall be judged under the statute of "unprincipled conduct."
translations.idiomatic: Whoever dares destroy, steal, or damage images of Buddha or the Heavenly Worthy, or the spirit forms of the peaks, guardian mountains, and rivers and seas, shall be judged under the statute of unprincipled conduct.

sentences.zh: 沙門壞佛像，道士壞天尊者，以惡逆論。」

translations.literal: Buddhist monks who destroy Buddha images, and Daoist priests who destroy Heavenly Worthy images, shall be judged under the statute of "treasonous wickedness."
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist monks who destroy Buddha images, and Daoist priests who destroy Heavenly Worthy images, shall be judged under the statute of treasonous wickedness."

translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the first day yimao, there was a solar eclipse.

translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, Senior General of the First Rank Dugu Kai was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yuan Province.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day renchen, Prince of Yuzhang Yang Zhan was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yang Province.

translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, Su Xiaoci, Prefect of Xi Province, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Hong Province.

translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day jichou, ninety thousand men and women of the Turks submitted.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, sudden rain, thunder, and great wind uprooted trees; the waters of the Yijun Pool shifted to Shiping.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day guichou, Su Xiaoci, Commander-in-Chief of Hong Province, died.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, sixteen envoys were dispatched to tour and inspect local customs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔曰：「儒學之道，訓教生人，識父子君臣之義，知尊卑長幼之序，升之於朝，任之以職，故能贊理時務，弘益風範。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, an edict stated: "The Way of Confucian learning instructs and nurtures the living; it teaches the relations of father and son, ruler and minister, and the order of senior and junior — elevating men to court and assigning them to office, they can thereby assist in governing affairs of the age and extend and enrich standards of conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, an edict stated: "The Way of Confucian learning instructs and nurtures the living; it teaches the relations of father and son and ruler and minister, and the order of senior and junior — when such men are elevated to court and assigned to office, they can assist in governing affairs of the age and extend and enrich standards of conduct.

sentences.zh: 朕撫臨天下，思弘德教，延集學徒，崇建庠序，開進仕之路，佇賢雋之人。

translations.literal: I rule the realm and wish to extend virtuous teaching, gathering students and building schools, opening the path to advancement and awaiting men of talent.
translations.idiomatic: I rule the realm and wish to extend virtuous teaching, gathering students and building schools, opening the path to advancement and awaiting men of talent and excellence.

sentences.zh: 而國學冑子，垂將千數，州縣諸生，咸亦不少。

translations.idiomatic: Yet the sons of the National University number nearly a thousand, and the students of the provinces and counties are also not few.

translations.idiomatic: They bear only empty names on the rolls and pass years in idleness; none have virtue to serve as models for the age or talent fit for state employment.

sentences.zh: 良由設學之理，多而未精。

translations.literal: This is truly because the principle of establishing schools is broad but not refined.
translations.idiomatic: This is truly because the principle of establishing schools has been broad but not refined.

sentences.zh: 今宜簡省，明加奬勵。

translations.literal: Now they should be simplified and reduced, with clear rewards and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Now they should be simplified and reduced, with clear rewards and encouragement."

translations.literal: " Thereupon the National University retained only seventy students; the Imperial University, the Four Gates, and the provincial and county schools were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the National University retained only seventy students; the Imperial University, the Four Gates, and the provincial and county schools were all abolished.

translations.idiomatic: That day, Buddhist relics were distributed to the provinces.

translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day wuxu, the National University was renamed the Imperial University.

translations.idiomatic: Longxi suffered an earthquake.

translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, Yang Da, Minister of Works, was appointed Chief Adviser to the Throne.
