translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiashen, an edict ordered Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Yang Su and various specialists to revise errors in yin-yang calendrical calculations.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the day jiashen, an edict ordered Left Vice Director Yang Su and various calendrical specialists to correct errors in yin-yang reckoning.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔曰：「禮之為用，時義大矣。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, an edict stated: "The use of ritual has great meaning for the age.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, an edict stated: "The use of ritual has great meaning for the age.

sentences.zh: 黃琮蒼璧，降天地之神，粢盛牲食，展宗廟之敬，正父子君臣之序，明婚姻喪紀之節。

translations.literal: Yellow jade and dark-green disks summon the spirits of Heaven and Earth; sacrificial grain and offerings of flesh display reverence for the Ancestral Temple; they set in order the relations of father and son, ruler and minister, and clarify the norms of marriage and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow jade and dark-green disks summon the spirits of Heaven and Earth; sacrificial grain and offerings of flesh display reverence for the Ancestral Temple, setting in order the relations of father and son and ruler and minister and clarifying the norms of marriage and mourning.

sentences.zh: 故道德仁義，非禮不成，安上治人，莫善於禮。

translations.literal: Therefore virtue and morality cannot be established without ritual; in settling superiors and governing people, nothing is better than ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore virtue and morality cannot be established without ritual; in settling superiors and governing the people, nothing surpasses ritual.

sentences.zh: 自區宇亂離，緜歷年代，王道衰而變風作，微言絕而大義乖，與代推移，其弊日甚。

translations.literal: Since the realm fell into disorder and separation, spanning many years, the royal Way declined and corrupt customs arose; subtle words ceased and great principles were lost; with each age they shifted, and the abuses grew daily worse.
translations.idiomatic: Since the realm fell into disorder and separation, spanning many years, the royal Way declined and corrupt customs arose. Subtle words ceased and great principles were lost; with each passing age the abuses grew worse.

sentences.zh: 至於四時郊祀之節文，五服麻葛之隆殺，是非異說，踳駁殊塗，致使聖教凋訛，輕重無準。

translations.literal: As for the ritual texts of the four seasonal suburban sacrifices, and the gradations of hemp and ramie in the five degrees of mourning dress — conflicting doctrines and contradictory paths caused the sage teaching to wither and err, with no standard for what is heavy or light.
translations.idiomatic: As for the ritual texts of the four seasonal suburban sacrifices and the gradations of hemp and ramie in the five degrees of mourning dress — conflicting doctrines and contradictory paths caused the sage teaching to wither and err, with no standard for what is heavy or light.

sentences.zh: 朕祗承天命，撫臨生人，當洗滌之時，屬干戈之代。

translations.literal: I reverently received Heaven's Mandate and rule over the living; at the time of renewal I was in an age of arms.
translations.idiomatic: I reverently received Heaven's Mandate and rule over the living; at the time of renewal I was in an age of arms.

sentences.zh: 克定禍亂，先運武功，刪正彝典，日不暇給。

translations.literal: Having conquered calamity and disorder, I first applied military achievement; revising the canonical statutes left no leisure even for a day.
translations.idiomatic: Having conquered calamity and disorder, I first applied military achievement; revising the canonical statutes left no day free.

sentences.zh: 今四海乂安，五戎勿用，理宜弘風訓俗，導德齊禮，綴往聖之舊章，興先王之茂則。

translations.literal: Now the four seas are at peace and the five barbarians need not be employed; it is fitting to extend custom and train the people, guide virtue and align ritual, restore the old statutes of former sages, and revive the flourishing norms of earlier kings.
translations.idiomatic: Now the four seas are at peace and the five barbarians need not be employed; it is fitting to extend custom and train the people, guide virtue and align ritual, restore the old statutes of former sages, and revive the flourishing norms of earlier kings.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射、越國公楊素，尚書右僕射、邳國公蘇威，吏部尚書、奇章公牛弘，內史侍郎薛道衡，祕書丞許善心，內史舍人虞世基，著作郎王劭，或任居端揆，博達古今，或器推令望，學綜經史。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Duke of Yue Yang Su, Right Vice Director and Duke of Pi Su Wei, Minister of Personnel and Duke of Qizhang Niu Hong, Secretariat Vice Director Xue Daohheng, Secretariat Aide Xu Shansin, Secretariat Attendant Yu Shiji, and Compiler Wang Shao — some hold the highest offices and are broadly versed in past and present; others are men of outstanding reputation, their learning comprehensive in the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Yang Su, Duke of Yue; Right Vice Director Su Wei, Duke of Pi; Minister of Personnel Niu Hong, Duke of Qizhang; Secretariat Vice Director Xue Daohheng; Secretariat Aide Xu Shansin; Secretariat Attendant Yu Shiji; and Compiler Wang Shao — some hold the highest offices and are broadly versed in past and present; others are men of outstanding reputation whose learning spans the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 委以裁緝，實允僉議。

translations.literal: Entrusting them with editing and compilation truly meets with general approval.
translations.idiomatic: Entrusting them with editing and compilation truly meets with general approval.

sentences.zh: 可並修定五禮。

translations.literal: They may together revise and fix the Five Rituals.
translations.idiomatic: They may together revise and fix the Five Rituals.

translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the third year, on the day jimao, Pang Huang, Commander-in-Chief of Yuan Province and Duke of Biyang, died.

translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, Yao Bian, Grand General and Duke of Caiyang, was appointed General of the Left Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸卯，詔曰：「哀哀父母，生我劬勞，欲報之德，昊天罔極。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the day guimao, an edict stated: "Alas, alas, my parents — in bearing me they toiled; I would repay their virtue, but boundless Heaven permits it not.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, on the day guimao, an edict stated: "Alas, alas, my parents — in bearing me they toiled; I would repay their virtue, but boundless Heaven permits it not.

sentences.zh: 但風樹不靜，嚴敬莫追，霜露既降，感思空切。

translations.literal: Yet the wind in the trees is unstill; solemn reverence cannot be recovered; frost and dew have already fallen, and my feeling of longing is empty and sharp.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the wind in the trees is unstill; solemn reverence cannot be recovered. Frost and dew have already fallen, and my longing is empty and sharp.

sentences.zh: 六月十三日，是朕生日，宜令海內為武元皇帝、元明皇后斷屠。」

translations.literal: The thirteenth day of the sixth month is my birthday; throughout the realm slaughter should be suspended for Emperor Wu of Yuan and Empress Yuanming."
translations.idiomatic: The thirteenth day of the sixth month is my birthday; throughout the realm slaughter should be suspended in honor of Emperor Wu of Yuan and Empress Yuanming."

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，詔曰：

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiawu, an edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day jiawu, an edict stated:

sentences.zh: 禮云：「至親以朞斷。

translations.literal: The Rites say: "For the closest kin, mourning ends at one year.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites say: "For the closest kin, mourning ends at one year.

sentences.zh: 」蓋以四時之變易，萬物之更始，故聖人象之。

translations.literal: " This is because the four seasons change and the myriad things begin anew; therefore the sages took them as models.
translations.idiomatic: " This is because the four seasons change and the myriad things begin anew; therefore the sages took them as models.

sentences.zh: 其有三年，加隆爾也。

translations.literal: When there is three years' mourning, it is because additional solemnity is added.
translations.idiomatic: When there is three years' mourning, it is because additional solemnity is added.

sentences.zh: 但家無二尊，母為厭降，是以父存喪母，還服于朞者，服之正也。

translations.literal: But in a household there cannot be two supreme authorities; the mother is subject to reduction because the father takes precedence — therefore when the father is alive and one mourns the mother, one returns to one-year mourning after the first year; this is the correct garment.
translations.idiomatic: But in a household there cannot be two supreme authorities; the mother is subject to reduction because the father takes precedence. Therefore when the father is alive and one mourns the mother, one returns to one-year mourning after the first year — this is the correct garment.

sentences.zh: 豈容朞內而更小祥！

translations.literal: How can one perform lesser mourning within the first year!
translations.idiomatic: How can one perform lesser mourning within the first year!

sentences.zh: 然三年之喪而有小祥者，禮云：「朞祭，禮也。

translations.literal: Yet in three years' mourning there is lesser mourning — the Rites say: "The one-year sacrifice is ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in three years' mourning there is lesser mourning — the Rites say: "The one-year sacrifice is ritual.

sentences.zh: 朞而除喪，道也。

translations.literal: Ending mourning at one year is the Way.
translations.idiomatic: Ending mourning at one year is the Way.

sentences.zh: 」以是之故，雖未再朞，而天地一變，不可不祭，不可不除。

translations.literal: " For this reason, though the second year has not yet come, once Heaven and Earth have changed once, sacrifice cannot be omitted and mourning cannot be retained.
translations.idiomatic: " For this reason, though the second year has not yet come, once Heaven and Earth have changed once, sacrifice cannot be omitted and mourning cannot be retained.

sentences.zh: 故有練焉，以存喪祭之本。

translations.literal: Therefore there is the practice of refined mourning, to preserve the root of mourning sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore there is the practice of refined mourning, to preserve the root of mourning sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 然朞喪有練，於理未安。

translations.literal: Yet one-year mourning with refined mourning is ritually unsound.
translations.idiomatic: Yet one-year mourning with refined mourning is ritually unsound.

sentences.zh: 雖云十一月而練，乃無所法象，非朞非時，豈可除祭。

translations.literal: Though it is said that refined mourning comes in the eleventh month, there is nothing to model it on; it is neither at one year nor at the proper season — how can mourning be ended and sacrifice performed?
translations.idiomatic: Though it is said that refined mourning comes in the eleventh month, there is nothing to model it on; it is neither at one year nor at the proper season — how can mourning be ended and sacrifice performed?

sentences.zh: 而儒者徒擬三年之喪，立練禫之節，可謂苟存其變，而失其本，欲漸於奪，乃薄於喪。

translations.literal: Confucian scholars merely imitated three years' mourning and established the stages of refined and final mourning — one may say they preserved a change but lost the root, wishing to diminish grief gradually yet making mourning too thin.
translations.idiomatic: Confucian scholars merely imitated three years' mourning and established the stages of refined and final mourning — one may say they preserved a change but lost the root, wishing to diminish grief gradually yet making mourning too thin.

sentences.zh: 致使子則冠練去絰，黃裏縓緣，絰則布葛在躬，粗服未改。

translations.literal: This caused the son to wear refined mourning and remove the headband, with yellow lining and hem, while the headband of hemp and ramie remained on the body and coarse garments were unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: This caused the son to wear refined mourning and remove the headband, with yellow lining and hem, while the headband of hemp and ramie remained on the body and coarse garments were unchanged.

sentences.zh: 豈非絰哀尚存，子情已奪，親疎失倫，輕重顛倒！

translations.literal: Is this not a case where grief for the headband still remains yet the son's feeling has already been taken away — near and distant lose their order, heavy and light are reversed!
translations.idiomatic: Is this not a case where grief for the headband still remains yet the son's feeling has already been taken away — near and distant lose their order, heavy and light are reversed!

sentences.zh: 乃不順人情，豈聖人之意也！

translations.literal: This does not accord with human feeling — how could it be the intent of the sages!
translations.idiomatic: This does not accord with human feeling — how could it be the intent of the sages!

sentences.zh: 故知先聖之禮廢於人邪，三年之喪尚有不行之者，至於祥練之節，安能不墜者乎？

translations.literal: Thus we know the rites of the former sages were abandoned by men — of three years' mourning there were already those who did not observe it; as for the stages of auspicious and refined mourning, how could they fail to fall away?
translations.idiomatic: Thus we know the rites of the former sages were abandoned by men — of three years' mourning there were already those who did not observe it; as for the stages of auspicious and refined mourning, how could they fail to fall away?

sentences.zh: 禮云：「父母之喪，無貴賤一也。

translations.literal: The Rites say: "In mourning for parents, noble and base are alike.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites say: "In mourning for parents, noble and base are alike.

sentences.zh: 」而大夫士之喪父母，乃貴賤異服。

translations.literal: " Yet when grandees and officers mourn parents, noble and base wear different garments.
translations.idiomatic: " Yet when grandees and officers mourn parents, noble and base wear different garments.

sentences.zh: 然則禮壞樂崩，由來漸矣。

translations.literal: Thus ritual was ruined and music collapsed — this has been a gradual process.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ritual was ruined and music collapsed — this has been a gradual process.

sentences.zh: 所以晏平仲之斬粗縗，其老謂之非禮，滕文公之服三年，其臣咸所不欲。

translations.literal: For this reason when Yan Pingzhong wore coarse hemp with the hem unfinished, his elders called it unritual; when Duke Wen of Teng observed three years' mourning, his ministers all disapproved.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason when Yan Pingzhong wore coarse hemp with the hem unfinished, his elders called it unritual; when Duke Wen of Teng observed three years' mourning, his ministers all disapproved.

sentences.zh: 蓋由王道既衰，諸侯異政，將踰越於法度，惡禮制之害己，乃滅去篇籍，自制其宜。

translations.literal: This was because the royal Way had already declined and the feudal lords each pursued a different policy; wishing to transgress law and measure, they hated ritual institutions that harmed themselves, and so destroyed the written records and made their own standards.
translations.idiomatic: This was because the royal Way had already declined and the feudal lords each pursued a different policy. Wishing to transgress law and measure, they hated ritual institutions that harmed themselves, and so destroyed the written records and made their own standards.

sentences.zh: 遂至骨肉之恩，輕重從俗，無易之道，隆殺任情。

translations.literal: Thereupon even the affection between kin, heavy and light, followed custom; there was no constant Way, and gradations of solemnity followed personal inclination.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon even the affection between kin, heavy and light, followed custom; there was no constant Way, and gradations of solemnity followed personal inclination.

sentences.zh: 況孔子沒而微言隱，秦滅學而經籍焚者乎！

translations.literal: How much more so after Confucius died and subtle words were hidden, and Qin extinguished learning and burned the classics!
translations.idiomatic: How much more so after Confucius died and subtle words were hidden, and Qin extinguished learning and burned the classics!

sentences.zh: 有漢之興，雖求儒雅，人皆異說，義非一貫。

translations.literal: When Han arose, though it sought Confucian refinement, every man had a different doctrine and the principles were not unified.
translations.idiomatic: When Han arose, though it sought Confucian refinement, every man had a different doctrine and the principles were not unified.

sentences.zh: 又近代亂離，唯務兵革，其於典禮，時所未遑。

translations.literal: Again in recent ages of disorder and separation, only military affairs were pursued; as for canonical ritual, there was no leisure for it.
translations.idiomatic: Again in recent ages of disorder and separation, only military affairs were pursued; as for canonical ritual, there was no leisure for it.

sentences.zh: 夫禮不從天降，不從地出，乃人心而己者，謂情緣於恩也。

translations.literal: Ritual does not descend from Heaven or rise from Earth — it is only of the human heart; one says that feeling arises from grace.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual does not descend from Heaven or rise from Earth — it is only of the human heart; one says that feeling arises from grace.

sentences.zh: 故恩厚者其禮隆，情輕者其禮殺。

translations.literal: Therefore where grace is deep, ritual is solemn; where feeling is light, ritual is reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore where grace is deep, ritual is solemn; where feeling is light, ritual is reduced.

sentences.zh: 聖人以是稱情立文，別親疎貴賤之節。

translations.literal: For this reason the sages weighed feeling to establish text, distinguishing the norms of near and distant, noble and base.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason the sages weighed feeling to establish text, distinguishing the norms of near and distant, noble and base.

sentences.zh: 自臣子道消，上下失序，莫大之恩，逐情而薄，莫重之禮，與時而殺。

translations.literal: Since the way of subject and son declined and high and low lost order, the greatest grace was thinned according to feeling, and the weightiest ritual was reduced according to the age.
translations.idiomatic: Since the way of subject and son declined and high and low lost order, the greatest grace was thinned according to feeling, and the weightiest ritual was reduced according to the age.

sentences.zh: 此乃服不稱喪，容不稱服，非所謂聖人緣恩表情，制禮之義也。

translations.literal: This is garments not matching mourning, appearance not matching garments — not what is meant by the sages' weighing grace to express feeling and establishing ritual.
translations.idiomatic: This is garments not matching mourning, appearance not matching garments — not what is meant by the sages weighing grace to express feeling and establishing ritual.

sentences.zh: 然喪與易也，寧在於戚，則禮之本也。

translations.literal: Yet mourning changes easily; better to dwell in grief — that is the root of ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Yet mourning changes easily; better to dwell in grief — that is the root of ritual.

sentences.zh: 禮有其餘，未若於哀，則情之實也。

translations.literal: When ritual has excess beyond this, it is not as good as genuine grief — that is the reality of feeling.
translations.idiomatic: When ritual has excess beyond this, it is not as good as genuine grief — that is the reality of feeling.

sentences.zh: 今十一月而練者，非禮之本，非情之實。

translations.literal: Now refined mourning in the eleventh month is not the root of ritual, not the reality of feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Now refined mourning in the eleventh month is not the root of ritual, not the reality of feeling.

sentences.zh: 由是言之，父存喪母，不宜有練。

translations.literal: From this it follows that when the father is alive and one mourns the mother, refined mourning is not appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: From this it follows that when the father is alive and one mourns the mother, refined mourning is not appropriate.

sentences.zh: 但依禮十三月而祥，中月而禫。

translations.literal: But according to ritual, auspicious mourning comes in the thirteenth month, and final mourning in the month between.
translations.idiomatic: But according to ritual, auspicious mourning comes in the thirteenth month, and final mourning in the month between.

sentences.zh: 庶以合聖人之意，達孝子之心。

translations.literal: In this way one may accord with the intent of the sages and reach the heart of the filial son.
translations.idiomatic: In this way one may accord with the intent of the sages and reach the heart of the filial son.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，詔曰：

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day dingmao, an edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day dingmao, an edict stated:

sentences.zh: 日往月來，唯天所以運序，山鎮川流，唯地所以宣氣。

translations.literal: Days pass and months come — only Heaven thus maintains sequence; mountains anchor and rivers flow — only Earth thus releases vapor.
translations.idiomatic: Days pass and months come — only Heaven thus maintains sequence; mountains anchor and rivers flow — only Earth thus releases vapor.

sentences.zh: 運序則寒暑無差，宣氣則雲雨有作，故能成天地之大德，育萬物而為功。

translations.literal: When sequence is maintained, cold and heat have no imbalance; when vapor is released, clouds and rain are produced — thus the great virtue of Heaven and Earth is accomplished and the myriad things are nourished to merit.
translations.idiomatic: When sequence is maintained, cold and heat have no imbalance; when vapor is released, clouds and rain are produced — thus the great virtue of Heaven and Earth is accomplished and the myriad things are nourished to merit.

sentences.zh: 況一人君于四海，睹物欲運，獨見致治，不藉羣才，未之有也。

translations.literal: How much more so for one man ruling the four seas, seeing the desires of things in motion — to achieve good order alone, without relying on many talents, has never happened.
translations.idiomatic: How much more so for one man ruling the four seas, seeing the desires of things in motion — to achieve good order alone, without relying on many talents, has never happened.

sentences.zh: 是以唐堯欽明，命羲、和以居岳，虞舜叡德，升元、凱而作相。

translations.literal: Therefore Tang Yao was reverently brilliant and appointed Xi and He to dwell on the peaks; Yu Shun was sagely in virtue and elevated Yuan and Kai as ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Tang Yao was reverently brilliant and appointed Xi and He to dwell on the peaks; Yu Shun was sagely in virtue and elevated Yuan and Kai as ministers.

sentences.zh: 伊尹鼎俎之媵，為殷之阿衡，呂望漁釣之夫，為周之尚父。

translations.literal: Yi Yin, attendant at the sacrificial vessel, became Yin's Chief Minister; Lü Wang, a man fishing with line, became Zhou's Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Yin, attendant at the sacrificial vessel, became Yin's Chief Minister; Lü Wang, a man fishing with line, became Zhou's Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 此則鳴鶴在陰，其子必和，風雲之從龍虎，賢哲之應聖明，君德不回，臣道以正，故能通天地之和，順陰陽之序，豈不由元首而有股肱乎？

translations.literal: This is like the crane calling in the shade — its young must respond; clouds and wind follow the dragon and tiger; the worthy respond to the sage and bright — when the ruler's virtue does not turn aside, the minister's way is corrected, and thus the harmony of Heaven and Earth is penetrated and the order of yin and yang is followed — is this not because the head has arms and legs?
translations.idiomatic: This is like the crane calling in the shade — its young must respond; clouds and wind follow the dragon and tiger; the worthy respond to the sage and bright. When the ruler's virtue does not turn aside, the minister's way is corrected, and thus the harmony of Heaven and Earth is penetrated and the order of yin and yang is followed — is this not because the head has arms and legs?

sentences.zh: 自王道衰，人風薄，居上莫能公道以御物，為下必踵私法以希時。

translations.literal: Since the royal Way declined, human customs grew thin; those above could not govern fairly to manage things, and those below inevitably followed private ways to seek the times.
translations.idiomatic: Since the royal Way declined, human customs grew thin; those above could not govern fairly to manage things, and those below inevitably followed private ways to seek favor with the times.

sentences.zh: 上下相蒙，君臣義失，義失則政乖，政乖則人困。

translations.literal: Above and below deceived one another; the righteousness between ruler and minister was lost — when righteousness was lost, government went awry; when government went awry, the people were distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Above and below deceived one another; the righteousness between ruler and minister was lost. When righteousness was lost, government went awry; when government went awry, the people were distressed.

sentences.zh: 蓋同德之風難嗣，離德之軌易追，則任者不休，休者不任，則眾口鑠金，戮辱之禍不測。

translations.literal: The wind of shared virtue was hard to continue; the track of divided virtue was easy to follow — then those who served did not rest, and those who rested did not serve; then many mouths melted gold, and the calamity of disgrace was unpredictable.
translations.idiomatic: The wind of shared virtue was hard to continue; the track of divided virtue was easy to follow — then those who served did not rest, and those who rested did not serve; then many mouths melted gold, and the calamity of disgrace was unpredictable.

sentences.zh: 是以行歌避代，辭位灌園，卷而可懷，黜而無慍，放逐江湖之上，沈赴河海之流，所以自潔而不悔者也。

translations.literal: For this reason men sang songs to avoid succession, declined office to irrigate gardens, what was rolled up could be kept in the bosom, and when dismissed there was no resentment; exiled upon rivers and lakes, sunk in the streams of river and sea — this was how they kept themselves pure and did not regret it.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason men sang songs to avoid succession, declined office to irrigate gardens, what was rolled up could be kept in the bosom, and when dismissed there was no resentment. Exiled upon rivers and lakes, sunk in the streams of river and sea — this was how they kept themselves pure and did not regret it.

sentences.zh: 至於閭閻秀異之士，鄉曲博雅之儒，言足以佐時，行足以勵俗，遺棄於草野，堙滅而無聞，豈勝道哉！

translations.literal: As for outstanding men of the lanes and wards, and learned Confucians of village and countryside — whose words could assist the age and whose conduct could encourage custom — abandoned in the wilds, buried and unheard of: how could one bear to speak of it!
translations.idiomatic: As for outstanding men of the lanes and wards, and learned Confucians of village and countryside — whose words could assist the age and whose conduct could encourage custom — abandoned in the wilds, buried and unheard of: how could one bear to speak of it!

sentences.zh: 所以覽古而歎息者也。

translations.literal: This is what causes one to sigh when reading the ancients.
translations.idiomatic: This is what causes one to sigh when reading of the ancients.

sentences.zh: 方今區宇一家，煙火萬里，百胜乂安，四夷賓服，豈是人功，實乃天意。

translations.literal: At present the realm is one family, beacon fires stretch ten thousand li, a hundred victories bring peace, and the four barbarians submit — this is not human achievement alone but truly Heaven's intent.
translations.idiomatic: At present the realm is one family, beacon fires stretch ten thousand li, a hundred victories bring peace, and the four barbarians submit — this is not human achievement alone but truly Heaven's intent.

sentences.zh: 朕惟夙夜祗懼，將所以上嗣明靈，是以小心勵己，日慎一日。

translations.literal: I am reverently fearful morning and night, wishing thereby to succeed the bright spirits above; therefore I restrain myself with care and grow more cautious day by day.
translations.idiomatic: I am reverently fearful morning and night, wishing thereby to succeed the bright spirits above; therefore I restrain myself with care and grow more cautious day by day.

sentences.zh: 以黎元在念，憂兆庶未康，以庶政為懷，慮一物失所。

translations.literal: With the black-haired masses in mind, I worry that the myriad people are not yet at ease; with the many affairs of government in heart, I fear that a single thing may be lost.
translations.idiomatic: With the black-haired masses in mind, I worry that the myriad people are not yet at ease; with the many affairs of government in heart, I fear that a single thing may be lost.

sentences.zh: 雖求傅巖，莫見幽人，徒想崆峒，未聞至道。

translations.literal: Though I seek a Fu Yue, I do not see the recluse; though I think of Mount Kongtong, I have not heard the utmost Way.
translations.idiomatic: Though I seek a Fu Yue, I do not see the recluse; though I think of Mount Kongtong, I have not heard the utmost Way.

sentences.zh: 唯恐商歌於長夜，抱關於夷門，遠跡犬羊之間，屈身僮僕之伍。

translations.literal: I only fear that men sing merchant songs through the long night, guard gates at Yimen, track far among dogs and sheep, and humble themselves in the ranks of servants.
translations.idiomatic: I only fear that men sing merchant songs through the long night, guard gates at Yimen, track far among dogs and sheep, and humble themselves in the ranks of servants.

sentences.zh: 其令州縣搜揚賢哲，皆取明知今古，通識治亂，究政教之本，達禮樂之源。

translations.literal: Let the provinces and counties search out and promote the worthy and wise — all who clearly know past and present, thoroughly understand order and disorder, investigate the root of government and teaching, and reach the source of ritual and music.
translations.idiomatic: Let the provinces and counties search out and promote the worthy and wise — all who clearly know past and present, thoroughly understand order and disorder, investigate the root of government and teaching, and reach the source of ritual and music.

sentences.zh: 不限多少，不得不舉。

translations.literal: There is no limit to number; none may fail to be recommended.
translations.idiomatic: There is no limit to number; none may fail to be recommended.

sentences.zh: 限以三旬，咸令進路。

translations.literal: Within thirty days all are ordered to come forward.
translations.idiomatic: Within thirty days all are ordered to come forward.

sentences.zh: 徵召將送，必須以禮。

translations.literal: When summoned and escorted, they must be treated with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: When summoned and escorted, they must be treated with ritual.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，上柱國、檢校幽州總管、落叢郡公燕榮以罪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day renshen, Senior General of the First Rank, Acting Commander-in-Chief of You Province, and Duke of Luocong Yan Rong was executed for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day renshen, Senior General of the First Rank, Acting Commander-in-Chief of You Province, and Duke of Luocong Yan Rong was executed for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，置常平官。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renxu, Ever-Normal granary officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day renxu, Ever-Normal granary officials were established.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以營州總管韋沖為民部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Wei Chong, Commander-in-Chief of Ying Province, was appointed Minister of the Household.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, Wei Chong, Commander-in-Chief of Ying Province, was appointed Minister of the Household.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，河南諸州水，遣納言楊達賑恤之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day guiyou, the Henan provinces suffered flooding; Chief Adviser Yang Da was dispatched to give relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day guiyou, the Henan provinces suffered flooding; Chief Adviser Yang Da was sent to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙辰，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the day bingchen, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the day bingchen, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸仁壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the emperor visited Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, the emperor visited Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔賞罰支度，事無巨細，並付皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, an edict ordered that rewards, punishments, and expenditures, whether great or small, all be entrusted to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, an edict ordered that rewards, punishments, and expenditures, whether great or small, all be entrusted to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，[23]上不豫。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day yimao, [23] the emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the day yimao, [23] the emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，[24]大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengshen, [24] a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day gengshen, [24] a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 有星入月中，數日而退。

translations.literal: A star entered the moon and after several days withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: A star entered the moon and after several days withdrew.

sentences.zh: 長人見於雁門。

translations.literal: A giant was seen at Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: A giant was seen at Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未，日青無光，八日乃復。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day yiwei, the sun was green and without light; after eight days it returned to normal.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day yiwei, the sun was green and without light; after eight days it returned to normal.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以大將軍段文振為雲州總管。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Duan Wenzhen, Grand General, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yun Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, Duan Wenzhen, Grand General, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yun Province.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上以疾甚，臥於仁壽宮，與百僚辭訣，並握手歔欷。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, as the emperor's illness was severe, he lay at Renshou Palace, took leave of the hundred officials, and clasped hands with them all, weeping.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen, as the emperor's illness was severe, he lay at Renshou Palace, took leave of the hundred officials, and clasped hands with them all, weeping.

sentences.zh: 丁未，崩於大寶殿，時年六十四。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he died at Dabao Hall at the age of sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, he died at Dabao Hall at the age of sixty-four.

sentences.zh: 遺詔曰：

translations.literal: The testamentary edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: The testamentary edict stated:

sentences.zh: 嗟乎！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 自昔晉室播遷，天下喪亂，四海不一，以至周、齊，戰爭相尋，年將三百。

translations.literal: Since ancient times when the Jin court was driven into exile, the realm fell into disorder, the four seas were not united — down through Zhou and Qi, war followed war for nearly three hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: Since ancient times when the Jin court was driven into exile, the realm fell into disorder and the four seas were not united — down through Zhou and Qi, war followed war for nearly three hundred years.

sentences.zh: 故割疆土者非一所，稱帝王者非一人，書軌不同，生人塗炭。

translations.literal: Thus those who carved out territories were not of one place, and those who called themselves emperors were not one man; writing and cart-tracks differed, and the living were scorched in misery.
translations.idiomatic: Thus those who carved out territories were not of one place, and those who called themselves emperors were not one man. Writing and cart-tracks differed, and the living were scorched in misery.

sentences.zh: 上天降鑒，爰命於朕，用登大位，豈關人力！

translations.literal: Heaven sent down its scrutiny and entrusted the Mandate to me; by this I ascended the great throne — how could it depend on human effort alone!
translations.idiomatic: Heaven sent down its scrutiny and entrusted the Mandate to me; by this I ascended the great throne — how could it depend on human effort alone!

sentences.zh: 故得撥亂反正，偃武修文，天下大同，聲教遠被，此又是天意欲寧區夏。

translations.literal: Therefore I was able to set right disorder and restore order, sheathe arms and cultivate letters, bring great unity to the realm, and extend teaching and influence far abroad — this again was Heaven's intent to bring peace to the central lands.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I was able to set right disorder and restore order, sheathe arms and cultivate letters, bring great unity to the realm, and extend teaching and influence far abroad — this again was Heaven's intent to bring peace to the central lands.

sentences.zh: 所以昧旦臨朝，不敢逸豫，一日萬機，留心親覽，晦明寒暑，不憚劬勞，匪曰朕躬，蓋為百姓故也。

translations.literal: For this reason I attend court at dawn and dare not indulge in ease; the myriad affairs of a day I personally review with care; through dark and light, cold and heat, I do not shrink from toil — this is not for my own body but for the sake of the people.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason I attend court at dawn and dare not indulge in ease. The myriad affairs of a day I personally review with care; through dark and light, cold and heat, I do not shrink from toil — this is not for my own body but for the sake of the people.

sentences.zh: 王公卿士，每日闕庭，刺史以下，三時朝集，何嘗不罄竭心府，誡勑殷勤。

translations.literal: Dukes, ministers, and scholars attend court daily; prefects and below assemble at court three times a day — when have I not exhausted my heart and admonished them earnestly?
translations.idiomatic: Dukes, ministers, and scholars attend court daily; prefects and below assemble at court three times a day — when have I not exhausted my heart and admonished them earnestly?

sentences.zh: 義乃君臣，情兼父子。

translations.literal: In righteousness we are ruler and minister; in feeling we are also like father and son.
translations.idiomatic: In righteousness we are ruler and minister; in feeling we are also like father and son.

sentences.zh: 庶藉百僚智力，萬國歡心，欲令率土之人，永得安樂，不謂遘疾彌留，至於大漸。

translations.literal: I hoped to rely on the intelligence of the hundred officials and the joy of the myriad states, wishing to make all within the realm forever secure and at ease — I did not expect to encounter lingering illness until the final decline.
translations.idiomatic: I hoped to rely on the intelligence of the hundred officials and the joy of the myriad states, wishing to make all within the realm forever secure and at ease — I did not expect to encounter lingering illness until the final decline.

sentences.zh: 此乃人生常分，何足言及！

translations.literal: This is the common lot of human life — what is there worth speaking of!
translations.idiomatic: This is the common lot of human life — what is there worth speaking of!

sentences.zh: 但四海百姓，衣食不豐，教化政刑，猶未盡善，興言念此，唯以留恨。

translations.literal: But the people of the four seas are not yet rich in food and clothing; teaching, government, and punishments are still not fully perfected — when I speak of this, I can only leave regret.
translations.idiomatic: But the people of the four seas are not yet rich in food and clothing; teaching, government, and punishments are still not fully perfected — when I speak of this, I can only leave regret.

sentences.zh: 朕今年踰六十，不復稱夭，但筋力精神，一時勞竭。

translations.literal: I am now past sixty and can no longer be called early-dead; but sinew, strength, and spirit have been exhausted at once.
translations.idiomatic: I am now past sixty and can no longer be called early-dead; but sinew, strength, and spirit have been exhausted at once.

sentences.zh: 如此之事，本非為身，止欲安養百姓，所以致此。

translations.literal: Such a matter was originally not for myself — I only wished to settle and nurture the people; that is why it came to this.
translations.idiomatic: Such a matter was originally not for myself — I only wished to settle and nurture the people; that is why it came to this.

sentences.zh: 人生子孫，誰不愛念，既為天下，事須割情。

translations.literal: Who among men does not love his children? Yet having the realm as one's charge, one must set feeling aside.
translations.idiomatic: Who among men does not love his children? Yet having the realm as one's charge, one must set feeling aside.

sentences.zh: 勇及秀等，並懷悖惡，既知無臣子之心，所以廢黜。

translations.literal: Yong, Xiu, and the others all harbored rebellious wickedness; once it was known they lacked the heart of subject and son, they were deposed.
translations.idiomatic: Yong, Xiu, and the others all harbored rebellious wickedness. Once it was known they lacked the heart of subject and son, they were deposed.

sentences.zh: 古人有言：「知臣莫若於君，知子莫若於父。

translations.literal: The ancients said: "No one knows a minister better than his ruler; no one knows a son better than his father.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said: "No one knows a minister better than his ruler; no one knows a son better than his father.

sentences.zh: 」若令勇、秀得志，共治家國，必當戮辱徧於公卿，酷毒流於人庶。

translations.literal: " If Yong and Xiu had gotten their way and jointly ruled the state and household, slaughter and humiliation would surely have spread among the grandees, and cruel poison would have flowed among the common people.
translations.idiomatic: " If Yong and Xiu had gotten their way and jointly ruled the state and household, slaughter and humiliation would surely have spread among the grandees, and cruel poison would have flowed among the common people.

sentences.zh: 今惡子孫已為百姓黜屏，好子孫足堪負荷大業。

translations.literal: Now the wicked descendants have been removed for the people's sake, and the good descendants are fully able to bear the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Now the wicked descendants have been removed for the people's sake, and the good descendants are fully able to bear the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 此雖朕家事，理不容隱，前對文武侍衞，具已論述。

translations.literal: Though this is my household affair, reason does not permit concealment; before the civil and military attendants I have already explained it in full.
translations.idiomatic: Though this is my household affair, reason does not permit concealment; before the civil and military attendants I have already explained it in full.

sentences.zh: 皇太子廣，地居上嗣，仁孝著聞，以其行業，堪成朕志。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Guang occupies the position of heir; his benevolence and filial piety are renowned; by his conduct and achievement he can fulfill my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Guang occupies the position of heir; his benevolence and filial piety are renowned; by his conduct and achievement he can fulfill my intent.

sentences.zh: 但令內外羣官，同心戮力，以此共治天下，朕雖瞑目，何所復恨。

translations.literal: Only let officials inside and outside unite in one heart and one effort to govern the realm together — though my eyes close, what regret remains?
translations.idiomatic: Only let officials inside and outside unite in one heart and one effort to govern the realm together — though my eyes close, what regret remains?

sentences.zh: 但國家事大，不可限以常禮。

translations.literal: But state affairs are great and cannot be limited by ordinary ritual.
translations.idiomatic: But state affairs are great and cannot be limited by ordinary ritual.

sentences.zh: 既葬公除，行之自昔，今宜遵用，不勞改定。

translations.literal: Ending public mourning after burial has been practiced from old; it should now be followed and need not be changed.
translations.idiomatic: Ending public mourning after burial has been practiced from old; it should now be followed and need not be changed.

sentences.zh: 凶禮所須，纔令周事。

translations.literal: What is needed for mourning rites should only suffice for completion.
translations.idiomatic: What is needed for mourning rites should only suffice for completion.

sentences.zh: 務從節儉，不得勞人。

translations.literal: Strive for thrift and do not burden the people.
translations.idiomatic: Strive for thrift and do not burden the people.

sentences.zh: 諸州總管、刺史已下，宜各率其職，不須奔赴。

translations.literal: Commanders-in-chief of provinces, prefects, and below should each perform their duties and need not rush to attend.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders-in-chief of provinces, prefects, and below should each perform their duties and need not rush to attend.

sentences.zh: 自古哲王，因人作法，前帝後帝，沿革隨時。

translations.literal: Since ancient times sage kings have made law according to men; former emperors and later emperors have changed and followed the times.
translations.idiomatic: Since ancient times sage kings have made law according to men; former emperors and later emperors have changed and followed the times.

sentences.zh: 律令格式，或有不便於事者，宜依前勑修改，務當政要。

translations.literal: Where statutes, orders, regulations, and formats are inconvenient to affairs, they should be revised according to prior edicts, with attention to governmental essentials.
translations.idiomatic: Where statutes, orders, regulations, and formats are inconvenient to affairs, they should be revised according to prior edicts, with attention to governmental essentials.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，敬之哉！

translations.literal: Alas — reverence!
translations.idiomatic: Alas — be reverent!

sentences.zh: 無墜朕命！

translations.literal: Do not fail my command!
translations.idiomatic: Do not fail my command!

sentences.zh: 乙卯，發喪。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, mourning was announced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, mourning was announced.

sentences.zh: 河間楊柳四株無故黃落，既而花葉復生。

translations.literal: Four willow trees at Hejian turned yellow and dropped their leaves for no reason, then afterward blossoms and leaves grew again.
translations.idiomatic: Four willow trees at Hejian turned yellow and dropped their leaves for no reason, then afterward blossoms and leaves grew again.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，梓宮至自仁壽宮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingmao, the coffin arrived from Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day dingmao, the coffin arrived from Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，殯于大興前殿。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the body was placed in coffin at the front hall of Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, the body was placed in coffin at the front hall of Daxing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，合葬於太陵，同墳而異穴。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jimao, joint burial was performed at Tailing — same mound but separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jimao, joint burial was performed at Tailing — same mound but separate chambers.

sentences.zh: 上性嚴重，有威容，外質木而內明敏，有大略。

translations.literal: The emperor's nature was stern and grave, with a dignified bearing; outwardly plain and wooden yet inwardly bright and keen, with great strategic vision.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's nature was stern and grave, with a dignified bearing; outwardly plain and wooden yet inwardly bright and keen, with great strategic vision.

sentences.zh: 初，得政之始，羣情不附，諸子幼弱，內有六王之謀，外致三方之亂。

translations.literal: At the beginning, when he first gained power, popular sentiment was not attached to him; his sons were young and weak; within there was plotting by the six princes, and without there was disorder on three fronts.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning, when he first gained power, popular sentiment was not attached to him; his sons were young and weak. Within there was plotting by the six princes, and without there was disorder on three fronts.

sentences.zh: 握強兵、居重鎮者，皆周之舊臣。

translations.literal: Those who held strong armies and occupied weighty commands were all old ministers of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Those who held strong armies and occupied weighty commands were all old ministers of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 上推以赤心，各展其用，不踰朞月，克定三邊，[25]未及十年，平一四海。

translations.literal: The emperor treated them with open heart and let each display his use; within less than a year the three frontiers were pacified, [25] and in less than ten years the four seas were unified.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor treated them with open heart and let each display his use. Within less than a year the three frontiers were pacified, [25] and in less than ten years the four seas were unified.

sentences.zh: 薄賦歛，輕刑罰，內修制度，外撫戎夷。

translations.literal: He reduced taxes and lightened punishments, reformed institutions within and pacified the barbarians without.
translations.idiomatic: He reduced taxes and lightened punishments, reformed institutions within and pacified the barbarians without.

sentences.zh: 每旦聽朝，日昃忘倦，居處服玩，務存節儉，令行禁止，上下化之。

translations.literal: Each dawn he heard court until the sun slanted and he forgot weariness; in dwelling, dress, and enjoyments he strove for thrift; when orders were issued and prohibitions enforced, above and below were transformed.
translations.idiomatic: Each dawn he heard court until the sun slanted and he forgot weariness. In dwelling, dress, and enjoyments he strove for thrift; when orders were issued and prohibitions enforced, above and below were transformed.

sentences.zh: 開皇、仁壽之間，丈夫不衣綾綺，而無金玉之飾，常服率多布帛，裝帶不過以銅鐵骨角而已。

translations.literal: Between Kaihuang and Renshou, men did not wear gauze silk, and there was no ornament of gold or jade; ordinary dress was mostly cloth and silk, and belts and fittings were no more than copper, iron, bone, and horn.
translations.idiomatic: Between Kaihuang and Renshou, men did not wear gauze silk, and there was no ornament of gold or jade. Ordinary dress was mostly cloth and silk, and belts and fittings were no more than copper, iron, bone, and horn.

sentences.zh: 雖嗇於財，至於賞賜有功，亦無所愛吝。

translations.literal: Though sparing with wealth, in rewarding merit he was never stingy.
translations.idiomatic: Though sparing with wealth, in rewarding merit he was never stingy.

sentences.zh: 乘輿四出，路逢上表者，則駐馬親自臨問。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage went out on the four roads and met someone submitting a memorial, he would halt his horse and personally inquire.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage went out on the four roads and met someone submitting a memorial, he would halt his horse and personally inquire.

sentences.zh: 或潛遣行人採聽風俗，吏治得失，人間疾苦，無不留意。

translations.literal: Or he secretly sent men to listen to local customs, the gains and losses of official governance, and the hardships of the people — none escaped his notice.
translations.idiomatic: Or he secretly sent men to listen to local customs, the gains and losses of official governance, and the hardships of the people — none escaped his notice.

sentences.zh: 嘗遇關中饑，遣左右視百姓所食。

translations.literal: Once when Guanzhong suffered famine, he sent attendants to see what the people were eating.
translations.idiomatic: Once when Guanzhong suffered famine, he sent attendants to see what the people were eating.

sentences.zh: 有得豆屑雜糠而奏之者，上流涕以示羣臣，深自咎責，為之徹膳不御酒肉者殆將一朞。

translations.literal: When one reported bean husks mixed with chaff, the emperor wept and showed it to the assembled ministers, deeply blaming himself; for this he withdrew from the evening meal and did not touch wine or meat for nearly a year.
translations.idiomatic: When one reported bean husks mixed with chaff, the emperor wept and showed it to the assembled ministers, deeply blaming himself. For this he withdrew from the evening meal and did not touch wine or meat for nearly a year.

sentences.zh: 及東拜太山，關中戶口就食洛陽者，道路相屬。

translations.literal: When he went east to worship at Mount Tai, households from Guanzhong seeking food at Luoyang lined the road one after another.
translations.idiomatic: When he went east to worship at Mount Tai, households from Guanzhong seeking food at Luoyang lined the road one after another.

sentences.zh: 上勑斥候，不得輒有驅逼，男女參廁於杖衞之間。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the scouts not to drive or press them; men and women mingled among the guard staffs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the scouts not to drive or press them; men and women mingled among the guard staffs.

sentences.zh: 逢扶老携幼者，輒引馬避之，慰勉而去。

translations.literal: When he met those supporting the old and leading the young, he would draw his horse aside to avoid them, comfort them, and then go on.
translations.idiomatic: When he met those supporting the old and leading the young, he would draw his horse aside to avoid them, comfort them, and then go on.

sentences.zh: 至艱險之處，見負擔者，遽令左右扶助之。

translations.literal: At dangerous places, when he saw burden-bearers, he immediately ordered attendants to help them.
translations.idiomatic: At dangerous places, when he saw burden-bearers, he immediately ordered attendants to help them.

sentences.zh: 其有將士戰沒，必加優賞，仍令使者就家勞問。

translations.literal: When officers and soldiers fell in battle, he always added generous rewards and sent envoys to their homes to offer consolation.
translations.idiomatic: When officers and soldiers fell in battle, he always added generous rewards and sent envoys to their homes to offer consolation.

sentences.zh: 自強不息，朝夕孜孜，人庶殷繁，帑藏充實。

translations.literal: Unceasing in self-strengthening, diligent morning and evening, the people grew numerous and the treasury was filled.
translations.idiomatic: Unceasing in self-strengthening, diligent morning and evening, the people grew numerous and the treasury was filled.

sentences.zh: 雖未能臻於至治，亦足稱近代之良主。

translations.literal: Though he could not reach perfect governance, he was enough to be called a good ruler of recent ages.
translations.idiomatic: Though he could not reach perfect governance, he was enough to be called a good ruler of recent ages.

sentences.zh: 然天性沉猜，素無學術，好為小數，不達大體，故忠臣義士莫得盡心竭辭。

translations.literal: Yet by nature he was deep and suspicious, utterly without learning, fond of petty calculations and not grasping the larger pattern — therefore loyal ministers and righteous men could not fully devote heart and words.
translations.idiomatic: Yet by nature he was deep and suspicious, utterly without learning, fond of petty calculations and not grasping the larger pattern — therefore loyal ministers and righteous men could not fully devote heart and words.

sentences.zh: 其草創元勳及有功諸將，誅夷罪退，罕有存者。

translations.literal: Of the founding meritorious officials and the generals who had achieved merit, those executed, condemned, or dismissed — few remained.
translations.idiomatic: Of the founding meritorious officials and the generals who had achieved merit, those executed, condemned, or dismissed — few remained.

sentences.zh: 又不悅詩書，廢除學校，唯婦言是用，廢黜諸子。

translations.literal: He also disliked poetry and the classics, abolished schools, listened only to women's words, and deposed his sons.
translations.idiomatic: He also disliked poetry and the classics, abolished schools, listened only to women's words, and deposed his sons.

sentences.zh: 逮于暮年，持法尤峻，喜怒不常，過於殺戮。

translations.literal: In his later years he held the law especially stern; joy and anger were inconstant, and killing exceeded measure.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he held the law especially stern; joy and anger were inconstant, and killing exceeded measure.

sentences.zh: 嘗令左右送西域朝貢使出玉門關，其人所經之處，或受牧宰小物饋遺鸚鵡、麖皮、馬鞭之屬，上聞而大怒。

translations.literal: Once he ordered attendants to escort Western Region tribute envoys out through Yumen Pass; wherever they passed, if they received small gifts from local governors — parrots, deer hides, horsewhips, and the like — when the emperor heard of it he was greatly enraged.
translations.idiomatic: Once he ordered attendants to escort Western Region tribute envoys out through Yumen Pass. Wherever they passed, if they received small gifts from local governors — parrots, deer hides, horsewhips, and the like — when the emperor heard of it he was greatly enraged.

sentences.zh: 又詣武庫，見署中蕪穢不治，於是執武庫令及諸受遺者，出開遠門外，親自臨決，死者數十人。

translations.literal: Again he went to the armory and saw the offices overgrown and untended; thereupon he seized the armory director and all who had received gifts, took them outside Kaiyuan Gate, and personally supervised execution — several tens died.
translations.idiomatic: Again he went to the armory and saw the offices overgrown and untended. Thereupon he seized the armory director and all who had received gifts, took them outside Kaiyuan Gate, and personally supervised execution — several tens died.

sentences.zh: 又往往潛令人賂遺令史府史，有受者必死，無所寬貸。

translations.literal: He also often secretly had men bribe clerks of the prefectures and departments; whoever accepted was put to death without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: He also often secretly had men bribe clerks of the prefectures and departments; whoever accepted was put to death without pardon.

sentences.zh: 議者以此少之。

translations.literal: Commentators for this reason slighted him.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators for this reason slighted him.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：高祖龍德在田，奇表見異，晦明藏用，故知我者希。

translations.literal: The historian says: When Gaozu's dragon virtue was in the fields, his extraordinary form appeared strange; hiding brightness and concealing his use, therefore those who knew him were few.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: When Gaozu's dragon virtue was in the fields, his extraordinary form appeared strange. Hiding brightness and concealing his use, those who knew him were few.

sentences.zh: 始以外戚之尊，受託孤之任，與能之議，未為當時所許，是以周室舊臣，咸懷憤惋。

translations.literal: At first, by the dignity of a maternal relative, he received the charge of a orphaned state; the deliberation on capability was not approved by the age — therefore the old ministers of Zhou all harbored indignation.
translations.idiomatic: At first, by the dignity of a maternal relative, he received the charge of an orphaned state. The deliberation on capability was not approved by the age — therefore the old ministers of Zhou all harbored indignation.

sentences.zh: 既而王謙固三蜀之阻，不踰朞月，尉迥舉全齊之眾，一戰而亡，斯乃非止人謀，抑亦天之所贊也。

translations.literal: Then Wang Qian held the barrier of the three Shu and within less than a month was overcome; Yu Jiong raised the full host of Qi and was destroyed in one battle — this was not only human planning but also Heaven's assistance.
translations.idiomatic: Then Wang Qian held the barrier of the three Shu and within less than a month was overcome; Yu Jiong raised the full host of Qi and was destroyed in one battle — this was not only human planning but also Heaven's assistance.

sentences.zh: 乘茲機運，遂遷周鼎。

translations.literal: Seizing this opportune movement, he thereupon moved the tripod of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Seizing this opportune movement, he thereupon moved the tripod of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 于時蠻夷猾夏，荊、揚未一，劬勞日昃，經營四方。

translations.literal: At that time the barbarians troubled Xia, Jing and Yang were not yet united; he toiled from dawn to dusk and managed affairs on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the barbarians troubled Xia, Jing and Yang were not yet united. He toiled from dawn to dusk and managed affairs on all four sides.

sentences.zh: 樓船南邁則金陵失險，驃騎北指則單于款塞，職方所載，並入疆理，禹貢所圖，咸受正朔。

translations.literal: When tower ships advanced south, Jinling lost its defenses; when the Rapid Cavalry pointed north, the Xiongnu submitted at the frontier; all recorded in the offices of duty entered the boundaries of rule, and all mapped in the Tribute of Yu received the correct calendar.
translations.idiomatic: When tower ships advanced south, Jinling lost its defenses; when the Rapid Cavalry pointed north, the Xiongnu submitted at the frontier. All recorded in the offices of duty entered the boundaries of rule, and all mapped in the Tribute of Yu received the correct calendar.

sentences.zh: 雖晉武之克平吳、會，漢宣之推亡固存，比義論功，不能尚也。

translations.literal: Though Jin Wu conquered Wu and Kuaiji, and Han Xuan pushed the perishing and consolidated the surviving — comparing righteousness and weighing merit, they cannot be placed above this.
translations.idiomatic: Though Jin Wu conquered Wu and Kuaiji, and Han Xuan pushed the perishing and consolidated the surviving — comparing righteousness and weighing merit, they cannot be placed above this.

sentences.zh: 七德既敷，九歌已洽，要荒咸暨，尉候無警。

translations.literal: Once the seven virtues were spread and the nine songs harmonized, the outermost lands all arrived and frontier scouts had no alarms.
translations.idiomatic: Once the seven virtues were spread and the nine songs harmonized, the outermost lands all arrived and frontier scouts had no alarms.

sentences.zh: 於是躬節儉，平徭賦，倉廩實，法令行，君子咸樂其生，小人各安其業，強無陵弱，眾不暴寡，人物殷阜，朝野歡娛。

translations.literal: Thereupon he personally practiced thrift, equalized corvée and taxes, filled granaries, enforced laws and orders; gentlemen all rejoiced in life, commoners each settled in their work; the strong did not bully the weak, the many did not oppress the few; people and things flourished, court and countryside were joyful.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he personally practiced thrift, equalized corvée and taxes, filled granaries, and enforced laws and orders. Gentlemen all rejoiced in life, commoners each settled in their work; the strong did not bully the weak, the many did not oppress the few. People and things flourished, and court and countryside were joyful.

sentences.zh: 二十年間，天下無事，區宇之內晏如也。

translations.literal: Within twenty years the realm had no affairs, and within the four quarters all was tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Within twenty years the realm had no affairs, and within the four quarters all was tranquil.

sentences.zh: 考之前王，足以參蹤盛烈。

translations.literal: Examining the former kings, he is enough to be compared with flourishing merit.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the former kings, he is enough to be compared with flourishing merit.

sentences.zh: 但素無術學，不能盡下，無寬仁之度，有刻薄之資，暨乎暮年，此風逾扇。

translations.literal: But he was utterly without learning in the arts, could not fully defer to subordinates, lacked the measure of generous benevolence, and had the material of harshness — in his later years this tendency fanned ever stronger.
translations.idiomatic: But he was utterly without learning in the arts, could not fully defer to subordinates, lacked the measure of generous benevolence, and had the material of harshness — in his later years this tendency fanned ever stronger.

sentences.zh: 又雅好符瑞，暗於大道，建彼維城，權侔京室，皆同帝制，靡所適從。

translations.literal: He also by nature loved omens and portents, was dark to the Great Way, built those wall-cities, made their authority equal to the capital — all on the imperial pattern, with nothing to follow.
translations.idiomatic: He also by nature loved omens and portents, was dark to the Great Way, built those wall-cities, and made their authority equal to the capital — all on the imperial pattern, with nothing to follow.

sentences.zh: 聽哲婦之言，惑邪臣之說，溺寵廢嫡，託付失所。

translations.literal: He listened to the words of a wise woman, was misled by wicked ministers, drowned favor and deposed the heir, and misplaced his trust.
translations.idiomatic: He listened to the words of a wise woman, was misled by wicked ministers, drowned favor and deposed the heir, and misplaced his trust.

sentences.zh: 滅父子之道，開昆弟之隙，縱其尋斧，翦伐本枝。

translations.literal: He extinguished the Way between father and son, opened a rift between brothers, indulged the search for the axe, and cut away the root branches.
translations.idiomatic: He extinguished the Way between father and son, opened a rift between brothers, indulged the search for the axe, and cut away the root branches.

sentences.zh: 墳土未乾，子孫繼踵屠戮，松檟纔列，天下已非隋有。

translations.literal: Before the grave mound was dry, sons and grandsons were slaughtered in succession; before the pine and cypress were set, the realm was already no longer Sui's.
translations.idiomatic: Before the grave mound was dry, sons and grandsons were slaughtered in succession; before the pine and cypress were set, the realm was already no longer Sui's.

translations.literal: Tracing the source of his decline and slackening, examining the omens of disorder and ruin — it began with Gaozu and was completed with Emperor Yang; the origin was far-reaching and not of a single morning or evening.
translations.idiomatic: Tracing the source of his decline and slackening, examining the omens of disorder and ruin — it began with Gaozu and was completed with Emperor Yang. The origin was far-reaching and not of a single morning or evening.

translations.literal: That his sacrifices ceased suddenly was not unlucky fortune.
